courses.summary:
1987 年，台積電以專業晶圓代工模式成立，把替客戶製造晶片作為核心業務。這個故事不只關於一座工廠，更關於設計與製造如何透過規格、製程能力與交付品質協作。新竹的台積創新館提供理解這段產業分工歷史的公共窗口。

本課程從這個地點延伸到晶圓上一層層圖形與材料的形成：某道工序的輸出，會成為下一道工序的條件。地圖標示的是博物館與產業聚落的代表點，並非所有製程的唯一生產地；課程的分步模型也不是台積電未公開的製造配方。
courses.summaryEn:
TSMC was established in 1987 around a dedicated foundry model, focusing on manufacturing customers’ chips. The story concerns more than a factory: it shows how design and manufacturing cooperate through specifications, process capabilities, and delivered quality. The TSMC Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu provides a public window into that industrial division of work.

The course extends this setting into the formation of successive material layers and patterns on a wafer. Each operation supplies conditions for the next. The map marks a museum and industry-cluster reference point, not the sole location of semiconductor production; the educational sequence is not TSMC’s undisclosed manufacturing recipe.

history.title: 專業晶圓代工模式起步
history.text: 張忠謀創辦台積電，專注於製造客戶的晶片，形成設計與製造分工的代表案例。
history.textEn: Morris Chang established TSMC with a focus on manufacturing customers’ chips, creating a prominent case of design–manufacturing specialization.

history.titleEn: The museum marks its fifth anniversary
history.text: 台積創新館發布五週年活動，顯示這段企業與半導體產業故事也透過公共展示傳承。
history.textEn: The museum announced fifth-anniversary activities, illustrating how this company and industry history is shared through public exhibitions.

courses.connection: 以博物館認識產業分工，再回到課程比較微影、蝕刻、薄膜、平坦化與量測的前後依賴。練習區分「設計意圖」「製造結果」及「驗證證據」。
courses.connectionEn: Use the museum to understand industrial specialization, then compare dependencies among patterning, etching, films, planarization, and measurement. Distinguish design intent, manufacturing outcome, and verification evidence.

courses.summary:
imec 於 1984 年在魯汶成立，其合作研究模式把晶片、材料、設備與設計的問題放在共同的研發環境裡討論。這使魯汶成為觀察先進製程如何從研究選項走向可驗證技術的代表地點，而不是某一家晶圓廠量產流程的替身。

2021 年的 imec 技術訪談把奈米片、forksheet 與後續元件構想連到接觸和金屬互連的挑戰。故事的重點是整合：元件變小，接觸電阻、佈線、材料與可靠度仍須共同改善。課程借此比較架構選項，不把研究路線圖當成已量產的共同配方。
courses.summaryEn:
Founded in Leuven in 1984, imec brings device, material, equipment, and design questions into a collaborative research environment. Leuven is therefore a representative setting for studying how advanced-process options become experimentally testable technologies, rather than a substitute for one foundry’s production flow.

A 2021 imec interview connected nanosheets, forksheets, and later device concepts with contact and interconnect challenges. Its central lesson is integration: smaller devices still require progress in resistance, routing, materials, and reliability. This course compares architecture options without treating a research roadmap as a universal production recipe.

history.title: 魯汶合作研究中心成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center begins in Leuven
history.text: imec 在佛蘭德政府支持下成立，逐步發展與半導體產業共同研究的模式。
history.textEn: Imec was established with Flemish government support and developed a model of research collaboration with the semiconductor industry.

history.title: 元件與互連共同縮微
history.titleEn: Device and interconnect scaling are linked
history.text: imec 公開討論奈米片、forksheet、接觸與後段互連之間的共同設計需求，並報告可運作 forksheet 元件的電性研究。
history.textEn: Imec discussed coupled device, contact, and interconnect development and reported electrical research on functioning forksheet devices.

courses.connection: 地圖連結研究園區；課程要求學徒把 GAA 元件截面、接觸、互連與量測結果放在同一張因果圖上，辨別概念、實驗展示及製造資格驗證。
courses.connectionEn: The map anchors a research campus. Connect GAA cross-sections, contacts, interconnects, and measurements in one causal diagram, separating concepts, experimental demonstrations, and manufacturing qualification.

courses.summary:
ASML 在 1984 年由 Philips 與 ASMI 共同創立，最初位於恩荷芬的一間簡陋廠房，隔年移入 Veldhoven 的辦公室與工廠。微影機的發展因此可以從一個實際的區域工程聚落講起：產品既需要原理突破，也需要能被組裝、校正及交付的系統。

2010 年，ASML 出貨首部 NXE:3100 預量產 EUV 系統；2013 年出貨首部 NXE:3300 生產系統。兩個節點提醒學徒，展示原理與滿足工廠使用要求之間仍有距離。Veldhoven 是研發與系統製造的代表園區，光學、光源及其他模組則涉及跨國合作與供應鏈。
courses.summaryEn:
ASML was founded by Philips and ASMI in 1984, initially working from a modest building in Eindhoven before moving to offices and a factory in Veldhoven in 1985. Lithography therefore offers a place-based engineering story: a product needs both scientific advances and a system that can be assembled, calibrated, and delivered.

ASML shipped its first NXE:3100 pre-production EUV system in 2010 and its first NXE:3300 production system in 2013. These milestones distinguish demonstrating a principle from meeting factory requirements. Veldhoven represents research and system manufacturing, while optics, sources, and other modules involve international partners and suppliers.

history.textEn: Shipment of the NXE:3100 in 2010 and the first NXE:3300 in 2013 marked distinct stages of industrialization.

courses.summary:
日月光於 1984 年在高雄開始第一座工廠的營運，之後把封裝與測試能力逐步整合。其歷史中的測試市場擴展與覆晶封裝量產，提供了一條從晶粒到可用電子元件的學習線索：晶圓製成後，工程工作並沒有結束。

本課程以楠梓的高雄園區作為代表地點，討論晶粒連接、散熱、機械支撐與測試如何共同決定封裝成效。地圖不代表所有先進封裝都在這裡製造；不同封裝架構與產品資格仍須分別驗證，也不能把企業里程碑當成每項產品的詳細流程。
courses.summaryEn:
ASE began operations at its first Kaohsiung factory in 1984 and subsequently expanded the combination of assembly and test capabilities. Its entry into semiconductor testing and volume flip-chip packaging offer a path from a bare die to a usable electronic component: engineering does not end when wafer fabrication finishes.

The course uses the Kaohsiung campus in Nanzih as a representative place for studying electrical connection, heat transfer, mechanical support, and test. The pin does not imply that all advanced packaging is manufactured there. Different architectures and product qualifications remain separate, and corporate milestones do not disclose detailed product flows.

history.titleEn: The first Kaohsiung factory begins operations
history.text: 張虔生與張洪本創辦日月光，首座工廠在高雄開始營運。
history.textEn: Jason Chang and Richard Chang established ASE, whose first factory began operations in Kaohsiung.

history.text: 日月光透過收購 ASE Test Limited 進入半導體測試市場。

history.textEn: ASE’s history records volume flip-chip production, providing a milestone for comparing wire-bond and area-array interconnect approaches.

courses.connection: 把高雄封測聚落連到課程的共同設計：在同一示意封裝中追蹤訊號、電源、熱量與機械應力，並指出每條路徑需要的驗證證據。
courses.connectionEn: Connect the Kaohsiung assembly-and-test cluster to co-design: trace signals, power, heat, and mechanical stress through one illustrative package and identify evidence for each path.

courses.summary:
AIM Photonics 於 2015 年成立，其羅徹斯特測試、組裝與封裝中心在 2018 年成為重要的能力節點。這個選址把積體光子的研究接到羅徹斯特既有的光學與光子產業背景，也把「晶片畫得出來」與「光能可靠地接進接出」之間的落差放到眼前。

矽光子的故事不只在晶圓內。光纖連接、晶粒整合、量測與封裝會決定原型能否成為可驗證的系統。地圖標示 TAP 場址；AIM Photonics 在 Albany 也有相關活動，因此這裡代表封裝與測試的一環，並非整條產業鏈的唯一地點。
courses.summaryEn:
AIM Photonics was established in 2015, and its Rochester Test, Assembly and Packaging facility became an important capability milestone in 2018. The location connects integrated photonics with Rochester’s optical-industry background and exposes the gap between designing a chip and coupling light into and out of a dependable system.

Silicon photonics extends beyond the wafer. Fiber attachment, integration, measurement, and packaging determine whether a prototype becomes a testable system. The map marks TAP; AIM Photonics also operates in Albany, so Rochester represents a packaging-and-test link rather than the entire chain.

history.title: AIM Photonics 成立
history.text: 2015 年 7 月的合作協議啟動研究機構，發展積體光子製造與人才能力。
history.textEn: A July 2015 cooperative agreement established the institute to develop integrated-photonics manufacturing and workforce capabilities.

history.title: 羅徹斯特 TAP 能力建立
history.text: TAP 中心的建立，將光子晶片的測試、組裝與封裝作為專門的共用研發能力。
history.textEn: The creation of TAP established dedicated shared development capability for photonic-chip testing, assembly, and packaging.

courses.connection: 從地圖上的封裝中心回到耦光損耗、對準、調變、光偵測與熱漂移。練習區分晶片內部性能與封裝完成後的端到端光鏈路性能。
courses.connectionEn: Link the packaging center to coupling loss, alignment, modulation, detection, and thermal drift. Distinguish on-chip performance from end-to-end performance after packaging.

courses.summary:
Fremont 的故事是既有汽車工廠如何換上新的產品架構。Tesla 於 2010 年買下原 NUMMI 工廠，並在同年正式揭幕；2012 年 6 月 22 日，首批 Model S 在此交付客戶。這兩個時間點把場址取得、製造準備與真正交車分開。

電動車仍需要車身、裝配及品質驗證，但電池、電力電子、電機與熱管理改變了系統之間的關係。本課程以 Fremont 作為量產整合的代表案例，學習介面與可追溯性；不把這座工廠視為 Tesla 的全部產能，也不宣稱公開資料揭露完整製造參數。
courses.summaryEn:
Fremont tells a story of an existing automotive plant adapted to a new product architecture. Tesla acquired the former NUMMI factory in 2010 and unveiled it that year; the first Model S customers received cars there on June 22, 2012. These dates separate acquiring a site, preparing production, and delivering vehicles.

Electric vehicles still need body manufacture, assembly, and verification, while batteries, power electronics, motors, and thermal management change system relationships. The course uses Fremont as a representative integration case, not Tesla’s entire production network or a source of undisclosed manufacturing settings.

history.title: 既有工廠轉為電動車生產基地

history.text: Tesla 於 5 月買下原 NUMMI 廠，10 月揭幕 Fremont 工廠。

history.title: 首批 Model S 交付
history.text: 6 月 22 日在 Fremont 工廠交付首批 Model S，讓產品開發與製造準備連到客戶使用。
history.textEn: The first Model S deliveries at Fremont on June 22 connected product development and production preparation to customer use.

courses.connection: 在課程中把電池、逆變器、電機、冷卻與車身介面畫成系統圖；比較單件檢測與整車驗證，並追蹤版本、裝配紀錄及測試結果。
courses.connectionEn: Map battery, inverter, motor, cooling, and body interfaces. Compare component checks with vehicle-level verification and trace configuration, assembly records, and test results.

courses.summary:
1947 年 3 月，第一部掛上 Ferrari 名稱的 125 S 在 Maranello 試行。這個故事可以從引擎與底盤開始，卻不能只停在性能數字：零件製造、燃油供應、裝配與測試，都會決定一輛車能否把設計表現帶到道路與賽道。

地圖以 Maranello 的法拉利博物館作為公共的歷史入口，連結附近的製造聚落。2024 年揭幕的 e-building 則呈現另一段轉變：同一基地規劃容納內燃機、混合動力及電動車相關生產。這是多種動力系統與製造能力演進的案例，不是所有車款共用的組裝配方。
courses.summaryEn:
In March 1947, the first car bearing the Ferrari name, the 125 S, was tested in Maranello. The story can begin with engine and chassis, but performance figures are insufficient: parts, fuel delivery, assembly, and testing determine whether a design works on the road and track.

The map uses Museo Ferrari as a public historical entry point to the nearby manufacturing cluster. The e-building inaugurated in 2024 represents another transition, designed to accommodate production associated with combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles. This is a case of evolving powertrains and manufacturing capability, not one assembly recipe for every model.

history.title: 125 S 在 Maranello 試行

history.text: 3 月 12 日，125 S 首次啟動並試行，成為 Ferrari 品牌歷史的重要起點。
history.textEn: On March 12, the 125 S was first started and tested, marking a formative moment in Ferrari history.

history.title: e-building 揭幕
history.text: 6 月 21 日揭幕的新廠房，規劃支援內燃機、混合動力與電動車生產。
history.textEn: The new building inaugurated on June 21 was designed to support combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicle production.

courses.connection: 從博物館的完整車輛反推引擎或電驅、底盤、熱管理與裝配介面；用零件公差、測試與故障證據解釋性能，而非僅以品牌或馬力評分。
courses.connectionEn: Work backward from complete vehicles to powertrain, chassis, thermal, and assembly interfaces. Explain performance through tolerances, tests, and failure evidence rather than brand or horsepower alone.

courses.summary:
2019 年 5 月，SpaceX 從卡納維爾角 SLC-40 發射一批 60 枚 Starlink 衛星。地圖選擇這個場址，是因為星系建設除了衛星製造，還需要把一批設備送入軌道，並在部署後逐一確認其狀態。這裡是代表性的發射地，不是 Starlink 衛星的製造工廠。

Starlink 的官方歷程將 2020 年列為服務上線的一年，提醒我們發射成功與形成可用通訊服務是不同里程碑。本課程把衛星、使用者終端、地面設施與網路交接放在同一系統圖中，討論覆蓋、延遲、容量與運維的取捨；不把單一地點或某年的統計當成整個星系的全貌。
courses.summaryEn:
In May 2019, SpaceX launched a batch of 60 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral’s SLC-40. The map uses this location because building a constellation requires deployment and verification after reaching orbit as well as spacecraft manufacture. It is a representative launch site, not the satellite factory.

Starlink’s official history identifies 2020 as the year service went live, distinguishing launch success from usable connectivity. The course connects satellites, user terminals, ground facilities, and network handovers in one system diagram to examine coverage, latency, capacity, and operations. One location or one year’s statistics cannot describe the whole constellation.

history.title: 60 枚衛星的批次部署任務
history.text: 5 月 23 日美國東岸時間的 Starlink 任務從 SLC-40 升空；國際日期為 5 月 24 日 UTC。
history.textEn: The Starlink mission lifted off from SLC-40 on May 23 Eastern time, corresponding to May 24 UTC.

history.title: 服務上線
history.text: Starlink 的官方歷程把 2020 年列為服務上線年；發射、軌道部署與地面服務因此可分開討論。
history.textEn: Starlink’s official history identifies 2020 as its service-launch year, separating launch, orbital deployment, and ground service milestones.

courses.connection: 由發射場切入批次部署與系統驗證，再回到低軌衛星、終端與地面網路的連接；練習分開發射成功、在軌可用及服務品質三種證據。
courses.connectionEn: Use the launch site to introduce batch deployment and verification, then connect low-orbit satellites, terminals, and ground networks. Separate evidence of launch success, orbital availability, and service quality.

courses.summary: 經國號的公開歷史，可以讀成一條從原型機出廠、首次飛行到生產階段完成的工程學習路線。這些節點的意義不同：外觀完整、開始飛行與穩定生產，分別需要不同的證據。本地點以漢翔台中廠區代表台灣航空製造網絡，並非宣稱全部工序集中於此；課程限於公開歷史、製造品質與工程安全。
courses.summaryEn: The public history of the Indigenous Defense Fighter offers a learning sequence from prototype rollout through first flight to completion of the production phase. These milestones require different evidence: a complete exterior, a flying prototype and repeatable production are distinct achievements. AIDC’s Taichung campus represents a wider aerospace network, rather than every production operation. The course covers public history, manufacturing quality and engineering safety.

history.title: 首架原型機出廠
history.text: 1988年12月10日，首架原型機A1出廠，並獲命名為經國號。對學徒而言，這是理解原型機與量產件差別的起點：展示一架整合完成的機體，不等於每項驗證都已完成。
history.textEn: The first A1 prototype rolled out on 10 December 1988 and received the Ching-kuo name. This milestone introduces the distinction between a prototype and a production article: presenting an integrated airframe is different from completing every verification activity.

history.title: 首次飛行
history.text: 1989年5月28日完成首次飛行。將它與前一年的出廠日期並列，可以看見「組合完成」與「進入飛行驗證」之間仍有一段工程工作；課程以公開里程碑練習安排驗證關卡。
history.textEn: The first flight took place on 28 May 1989. Comparing this date with rollout makes the interval between physical integration and flight verification visible. Learners use these public milestones to reason about verification gates.

history.title: 生產階段完成
history.text: 漢翔的公開沿革記載，1999年底完成第130架量產機，結束該生產階段。這提供一個討論重複製造的切入點：工程圖版本、零件追溯與檢驗紀錄，如何讓不同批次維持一致。
history.textEn: AIDC records completion of the 130th production aircraft at the end of 1999, closing that production phase. This provides a starting point for discussing repeatability: drawing revisions, part traceability and inspection records help control variation between batches.

courses.connection: 相鄰的土木工程課題是機棚、跑道與製造廠房：機體、地面設備及建築空間必須使用一致的尺寸介面。可先用民用機棚的示意模型練習淨空、通道和維修動線，再把「有圖、有量測、有驗證」的思考轉移到橋梁構件或捷運車體；不延伸至武器製造。
courses.connectionEn: Adjacent civil-engineering topics include hangars, runways and manufacturing buildings, where aircraft, ground equipment and structures share dimensional interfaces. Use a conceptual civilian hangar model to study clearances, access and maintenance routes, then transfer drawing, measurement and verification habits to bridge components or metro bodies. Weapon construction is outside this course.

courses.summary: 阿帕契的公開故事跨越原型試飛與長期製造。波音官方介紹將梅薩列為建造及測試所在地，因此本課程用它作為旋翼航空產業的代表地點。學習重點是公開的發展時間線、品質管理與安全意識；地圖不表示廠區開放參觀，也不提供武器、戰術或作戰系統的製作細節。
courses.summaryEn: The Apache’s public story spans prototype flight and long-term manufacturing. Boeing identifies Mesa as a location where Apaches are built and tested, so this course uses it to represent the rotorcraft industry. Learning focuses on the public timeline, quality management and safety. The map does not imply public access, and the course provides no weapon, tactical or combat-system construction details.

history.title: 原型機首次飛行
history.text: 波音在首飛25週年的官方回顧中記載，首次飛行發生於1975年9月30日。把原型階段放在時間線的前端，有助於理解研發驗證與日後交付並不是同一件事。
history.textEn: Boeing’s official 25th-anniversary account dates the first flight to 30 September 1975. Placing the prototype phase at the beginning of the timeline helps separate development verification from later delivery.

history.title: 開始交付
history.text: 波音官方資料記載首批交付始於1984年。首飛到交付的多年跨度，可用來討論複雜航空專案如何逐步成熟；不能把兩個年份之間的全部工作，簡化成一條固定的組裝配方。
history.textEn: Boeing dates the first deliveries to 1984. The years between first flight and delivery support discussion of how a complex aviation project matures; they should not be reduced to a single universal assembly recipe.

courses.connection: 可轉向民用旋翼機的機棚、停機坪與救援基地，研究建築淨空、消防分區及地面作業流程。再與捷運維修廠比較：兩者都需要把設備、工作人員與檢驗紀錄安排成可追溯的流程，但運動型態、載荷與適用規範不同。
courses.connectionEn: A useful civilian connection is the design of rotorcraft hangars, aprons and rescue bases: building clearances, fire compartments and ground workflows must fit their users. Compare these with metro maintenance depots. Both organize equipment, people and inspection records into traceable processes, while their motion, loads and governing standards differ.

courses.summary: 海鯤原型艦的公開歷史，適合用來辨識大型造船案的不同階段：開工、命名與下水典禮，各自只代表特定的進展。高雄台船據點是本課程的產業地理錨點，不是開放參觀或所有工序的保證。教學採公開歷史、一般造船品質與安全管理，不涉及作戰性能或潛艦製造參數。
courses.summaryEn: The public history of the Hai Kun prototype helps distinguish stages in a large shipbuilding project: construction commencement, naming and a launch ceremony each mark specific progress. CSBC’s Kaohsiung site is the course’s industrial geography anchor, not a promise of public access or a claim that every operation occurs there. Teaching covers public history, general shipbuilding quality and safety, without combat performance or submarine manufacturing parameters.

history.title: 建造案開工典禮
history.text: 2020年11月24日，總統府記錄了在高雄台船公司舉行的建造案開工典禮。公開敘述提到預算、簽約、設計與廠房準備，提醒學徒：可見的製造工作之前，已存在專案與基礎設施的準備。
history.textEn: The Presidential Office records a construction commencement ceremony at CSBC in Kaohsiung on 24 November 2020. Its public account describes prior budgeting, contracting, design and facility preparation, showing that project and infrastructure work precedes visible manufacturing.

history.title: 命名暨下水典禮
history.text: 2023年9月28日舉行原型艦命名暨下水典禮，名稱為海鯤。這裡保留官方對事件的稱呼，不把典禮日期改寫成完成全部測試、交付或服役日期；大型專案需要逐項辨識驗證狀態。
history.textEn: The prototype naming and launch ceremony was held on 28 September 2023, with the name Hai Kun. The event is kept distinct from completion of all testing, delivery or commissioning. Large projects require verification status to be identified milestone by milestone.

courses.connection: 相鄰課題可選港灣、船塢與民用船舶：比較塢體、排水設備、起重設施和人員通道如何共同服務建造流程。可用一般貨船的分段示意圖學習工序依賴、檢驗停留點與防蝕紀錄，再與橋梁鋼構的製造追溯比較。
courses.connectionEn: Adjacent topics include harbors, dry docks and civilian vessels. Compare how dock structures, drainage, lifting facilities and personnel access support a construction workflow. A generic cargo-ship block diagram can teach dependencies, inspection hold points and corrosion-protection records, then be compared with traceability for fabricated bridge steelwork.

courses.summary: 淡江大橋把跨河交通、結構工程和淡水河口景觀放進同一個設計問題。它的故事不只是一座橋塔的造型：橋型競圖、施工合龍、設備整備及開放交通，是不同的決策與驗證階段。地圖標示主橋周邊的概略代表位置，適合與淡水、八里及河口地形一同觀察。
courses.summaryEn: Danjiang Bridge brings river-crossing transport, structural engineering and the Tamsui estuary landscape into one design problem. Its story extends beyond the tower’s appearance: the design competition, structural closure, system readiness and opening to traffic are different decision and verification stages. The map marks an approximate representative location at the main crossing for reading the bridge alongside Tamsui, Bali and the estuary.

history.title: 橋型國際競圖完成
history.text: 公路局回顧記載，國際競圖於2015年8月完成，選定單塔不對稱斜張橋。地方文化、夕照景觀與環境條件參與了方案選擇，說明工程需求可以同時包含交通功能與場所感。
history.textEn: The Highway Bureau’s retrospective dates completion of the international competition to August 2015, selecting a single-tower asymmetrical cable-stayed form. Local culture, sunset views and environmental conditions informed the choice, illustrating how engineering requirements can include both transport function and sense of place.

history.title: 主橋合龍
history.text: 公路局記載2025年9月16日完成合龍。合龍後仍需照明、鋪面、索力調整、吊車拆除、載重試驗及查驗等整備；「結構接起來」並不直接等於「已可通車」。
history.textEn: The Highway Bureau records bridge closure on 16 September 2025. Lighting, paving, cable-force adjustment, crane removal, load testing and inspection followed. Connecting the structure was therefore distinct from being ready for traffic.

history.title: 正式開放車輛通行
history.text: 依公路局2026年5月13日說明，5月9日舉辦啟用活動，5月12日上午11時30分正式通車。這裡以已公布的實際事件區分活動日與交通開放日，不沿用早期預定完工日期。
history.textEn: According to the Highway Bureau’s 13 May 2026 statement, inauguration activities took place on 9 May and traffic formally opened at 11:30 on 12 May. These reported events distinguish the ceremony from traffic access rather than repeating earlier projected completion dates.

courses.connection: 可與雪山隧道比較「跨越障礙」的兩種方法：橋梁把路線抬過河口，隧道讓路線穿過山體。總工程師仍需統整地質、水文、結構、施工順序及使用者安全；學生可建立共同的需求清單，再標出河道與地下環境各自新增的限制。
courses.connectionEn: Compare two ways of crossing an obstacle: the bridge carries a route over an estuary, while Hsuehshan Tunnel carries one through a mountain. Both require coordination of geology, water, structures, construction sequence and user safety. Learners can create a shared requirements list and then identify the distinct constraints imposed by a river channel and an underground setting.

courses.summary: 雪山隧道的故事，是地質不確定性、施工方法與長期協作交織的案例。南口文物館保留隧道鑽掘機模型、剖面與施工歷程，讓看不見的地下工作有了可觀察的入口。從導坑開工到通車的時間線，也提醒學徒把貫通、設備整合與營運準備分開理解。
courses.summaryEn: Hsuehshan Tunnel is a case study in geological uncertainty, construction methods and sustained collaboration. The museum near the south portal uses tunnel-boring-machine models, sections and construction records to make underground work observable. Its timeline from pilot-tunnel construction to traffic opening also separates breakthrough from system integration and operational readiness.

history.title: 導坑工程開工
history.text: 高速公路局大事紀記錄1991年7月15日導坑工程開工。先把導坑與後續主隧道區分，能幫助學徒理解不同工作面、地質資訊及施工階段之間的關係。
history.textEn: The Freeway Bureau dates the start of pilot-tunnel construction to 15 July 1991. Distinguishing the pilot tunnel from the later main tunnels helps learners relate work fronts, geological information and construction stages.

history.title: 全線貫通
history.text: 2004年9月16日完成全線貫通。這是地下開挖的重要節點，卻仍不是車流可以立即進入的終點；課程把它作為從土建工作轉向後續系統整備的討論關卡。
history.textEn: Full breakthrough was achieved on 16 September 2004. It was a major excavation milestone, but did not itself mean traffic could immediately enter. The course uses it to discuss the transition from civil construction to subsequent system readiness.

history.title: 通車營運
history.text: 2006年6月16日通車。將此日期與2004年的貫通並列，可練習追問：在一條可安全使用的公路隧道裡，除了空間被挖通，還必須準備哪些設備、程序與驗證證據？
history.textEn: The tunnel opened to traffic on 16 June 2006. Setting this beside the 2004 breakthrough invites a practical question: beyond an excavated passage, which systems, procedures and verification evidence are needed for a usable road tunnel?

courses.connection: 相鄰工程可連到捷運隧道、抽水站與地下車站。用原創剖面圖標示交通空間、排水及通風的介面，再比較道路隧道與軌道隧道的使用情境。這種介面分析可延伸至礦山、地下實驗室與大型建築的機電整合。
courses.connectionEn: Related civil works include metro tunnels, pumping stations and underground stations. Use an original section diagram to mark interfaces among traffic space, drainage and ventilation, then compare road and rail operating contexts. This interface analysis also transfers to mines, underground laboratories and building-services integration.

place.mapQuery: National Railway Museum Leeman Road York
place.address: National Railway Museum Leeman Road York

courses.summary: 約克的國家鐵路博物館讓蒸汽機車從退役設備變成可持續研究的工程證據。以Mallard與A4系列為一個具體入口，可以把熱機、車輪連桿、車體外形與鐵路系統放在一起觀察；它只是眾多蒸汽機車設計中的一支，不能代表所有年代與國家的製造方法。
courses.summaryEn: York’s National Railway Museum turns retired railway equipment into enduring engineering evidence. Mallard and the A4 family provide a concrete entry point for observing heat engines, wheel linkages, body form and the railway system together. They represent one design family, not the manufacturing methods of every period or country.

history.title: Mallard的速度紀錄
history.text: 1938年7月3日，Mallard達到每小時126英里的蒸汽機車速度紀錄。課程不把紀錄視為日常運行條件，而是請學徒分辨單次試驗成果、日常服務與維修負擔這三種不同問題。
history.textEn: On 3 July 1938, Mallard reached a steam-locomotive speed record of 126 mph. The course treats this as a record run rather than a routine operating condition, inviting learners to distinguish a test achievement, everyday service and maintenance burden.

history.title: 舊車庫成為公共博物館
history.titleEn: A former depot becomes a public museum
history.text: 國家鐵路博物館於1975年在約克開館，利用舊有動力車庫轉作展示空間。工程故事因此多了一層：保存機車也需要建築再利用、展品支承與知識整理。
history.textEn: The National Railway Museum opened in York in 1975, adapting a former motive-power depot for display. This adds another engineering layer: preserving locomotives also involves building reuse, exhibit support and the organization of knowledge.

history.title: 六輛存世A4機車相聚
history.text: 為紀念Mallard紀錄75週年，六輛存世A4機車於2013年在約克相聚。並置觀察提供一個學習方法：同一設計家族的外觀相似，不表示每輛車的使用經歷與保存狀態相同。
history.textEn: For the record’s 75th anniversary, all six surviving A4 locomotives gathered in York in 2013. Side-by-side observation offers a learning method: similar appearance within a design family does not imply identical service histories or conservation condition.

courses.connection: 蒸汽機車能連到鐵路橋梁、路基、車站與給水設施：車輛再強，也必須與軌道承載、轉彎及服務設施共同工作。可用縮尺示意模型比較蒸汽與電力牽引的能量流，再討論歷史車庫改作博物館時的結構與保存需求；不進行實體鍋爐製造或加壓實驗。
courses.connectionEn: Steam locomotives connect naturally to railway bridges, track foundations, stations and water facilities: a vehicle works within track-load, curve and servicing constraints. Use a scale schematic to compare steam and electric traction energy flows, then discuss structural and conservation needs when adapting a historic depot into a museum. No physical boiler construction or pressurization experiment is involved.

courses.summary: 三峽工程適合用「一個水利樞紐，多種相互牽動的功能」來閱讀：大壩、水庫、電站與通航設施需要共同運作。三斗坪的地理位置讓學徒能從河流尺度理解工地，而不是只看一座混凝土構造物。工程課程也應把長期維護、上下游使用者與環境影響列入問題清單。
courses.summaryEn: The Three Gorges project is best read as one water-control complex with interacting functions: the dam, reservoir, power station and navigation facilities operate together. Its Sandouping location lets learners consider the river scale rather than only a concrete structure. Long-term maintenance, upstream and downstream users, and environmental effects also belong in the engineering questions.

history.title: 工程正式開工
history.text: 三峽集團記載，工程於1994年12月14日正式開工。這是理解大型分期工程的起點：施工準備、河道處理與永久設施並非同時完成，時間線需要顯示各階段的依賴。
history.textEn: China Three Gorges records the formal start of construction on 14 December 1994. It provides a starting point for studying phased works: preparation, river management and permanent facilities are not completed simultaneously, so the timeline must reveal dependencies.

history.title: 蓄水、通航與發電進入新階段
history.titleEn: Impoundment, navigation and power enter a new phase
history.text: 2003年完成二期工程蓄水、通航與發電目標。三項里程碑放在同一年，不代表它們是同一個動作；課程可分別畫出水庫、船閘及機組的功能介面，討論跨系統驗證。
history.textEn: In 2003 the project achieved its second-phase goals for impoundment, navigation and power generation. Occurring in one year does not make these a single operation. Learners can map reservoir, lock and generating-unit interfaces separately to discuss verification across systems.

history.title: 主發電機組全部投運
history.titleEn: All main generating units enter operation
history.text: 長江電力的工程介紹記載，2012年7月全部32台70萬千瓦主機組投入運行。從1994年的開工走到機組陸續投運，顯示大型基礎設施往往以分期建造、分期使用的方式形成。
history.textEn: China Yangtze Power records all 32 main 700 MW generating units entering operation in July 2012. The interval from the 1994 start to successive unit commissioning illustrates how large infrastructure can be built and brought into use in phases.

courses.connection: 可連到抽蓄水力、船閘、河港與跨河橋梁。先用水位與能量的示意模型區分發電、調蓄及船舶通過的目的，再比較不同操作情境的限制。工程成功的討論應同時提出結構安全、設備可靠性與河川系統影響的證據需求。
courses.connectionEn: Related topics include pumped storage, navigation locks, river ports and bridges. Begin with schematic water-level and energy models to distinguish generation, storage and vessel passage, then compare constraints under different operating scenarios. Evaluating success should identify evidence needs for structural safety, equipment reliability and effects on the river system.

courses.summary: 動物園站把抽象的捷運系統落在一個可以辨識的城市地點。臺北捷運從木柵線的中運量系統開始，逐步加入不同路線與運輸型式。車輛、軌道、控制、供電和車站需要彼此配合，因此本課程把「能動的車」與「能持續服務的路網」當成不同層次的工程目標。
courses.summaryEn: Taipei Zoo Station anchors an abstract metro system in a recognizable urban place. Taipei Metro began with the medium-capacity Muzha Line and expanded into a network with different lines and system types. Vehicles, guideways, control, power and stations must work together, so this course distinguishes a moving vehicle from a network capable of sustained service.

history.title: 木柵線開始營運
history.text: 1996年3月28日，木柵線通車，成為臺北捷運首條營運路線。它提供一個具體的系統邊界：車站、導軌與自動化車輛必須一起被理解，不能只把捷運看成車頭與車廂。
history.textEn: On 28 March 1996, the Muzha Line became Taipei Metro’s first operating line. It offers a concrete system boundary: stations, guideways and automated vehicles must be understood together rather than reducing a metro to a train and its cars.

history.title: 高運量淡水線加入
history.text: 臺北捷運大事紀記載，1997年3月28日淡水線淡水至中山段通車。從中運量到高運量，可練習比較運輸需求與系統選型；不同路線不能直接套用相同的車輛及控制假設。
history.textEn: Taipei Metro’s chronology records the Tamsui-to-Zhongshan section opening on 28 March 1997. The addition of a high-capacity line supports comparison of demand and system selection; identical vehicle and control assumptions cannot simply be applied to every line.

history.title: 內湖線延伸與系統相容
history.text: 2009年7月4日內湖線通車，與既有木柵線銜接。捷運工程局指出，新舊機電系統相容是擴充時的重要課題；這個故事適合用來討論延伸一條運行中的路線，為何涉及既有介面的整合。
history.textEn: The Neihu extension opened on 4 July 2009 and connected with the existing Muzha Line. The Department of Rapid Transit Systems identifies compatibility between the new and existing electromechanical systems as a key expansion issue, illustrating why extending an operating route requires interface integration.

courses.connection: 相鄰土木工程包括高架橋、隧道、地下車站與維修機廠。可把同一段捷運需求分配到車輛、供電、訊號及土建四張示意圖，再檢查月台介面、設備空間和維修通道是否一致。這種跨專業比對也適用於機場、港口與大型醫院。
courses.connectionEn: Adjacent civil works include viaducts, tunnels, underground stations and maintenance depots. Allocate the requirements for one metro section across vehicle, power, signaling and civil schematics, then compare platform interfaces, equipment space and maintenance access. This cross-discipline checking also applies to airports, ports and large hospitals.

courses.summary:
一片可製作晶片的矽晶圓，先需要把材料、幾何及表面狀態控制好。伊萬里是 SUMCO 公開列出的九州工廠所在地之一，可作為認識基板製造與後續晶片製程分工的地理入口。

SUMCO 前身於 1999 年為 300 mm 晶圓開發製造成立合資企業，2002 年整合既有矽晶圓業務。這些是企業歷史節點，不是本課程十二步的量產起點。地圖座標為城市代表位置，地址查詢指向官方列示的工廠；不表示所有晶圓都在此製造，也不表示工廠開放參觀。
courses.summaryEn:
A wafer suitable for chipmaking first needs controlled material, geometry and surface condition. Imari hosts a Kyushu factory listed by SUMCO and provides a geographic introduction to the division between substrate manufacturing and later chip fabrication.

SUMCO’s predecessor was formed in 1999 for 300 mm wafer development and manufacturing, and integrated existing wafer businesses in 2002. These are company-history milestones, not the origin of this course’s twelve-step teaching sequence. Coordinates represent the city; the address query points to the officially listed factory. Neither exclusive manufacturing nor public factory access is implied.

history.textEn: The company acquired Sumitomo Metal’s wafer business and merged with Mitsubishi Materials Silicon, becoming Sumitomo Mitsubishi Silicon Corp.

晶圓接合的進步需要材料、對位與設備工程一起發展。EV Group 在奧地利的總部提供一個理解精密設備供應如何支援半導體整合的代表地點。

公司於 1980 年成立，並於 1999 年推出面對面晶圓對位技術 SmartView。歷史強調的是介面可被對準、量測及重複處理的重要性；本課程不將某一公司的設備史當成所有混合接合的唯一來源。座標為城鎮代表點，官方地址供地圖查詢，未聲稱廠区開放參觀。

Progress in wafer bonding combines materials, alignment and equipment engineering. EV Group’s Austrian headquarters is a representative setting for understanding how precision-equipment suppliers support semiconductor integration.

The company was founded in 1980 and introduced SmartView face-to-face wafer alignment in 1999. The history emphasizes interfaces that can be aligned, measured and processed repeatably; it does not make one supplier the sole origin of hybrid bonding. Coordinates represent the town and the official address supports map lookup, without implying public factory access.

courses.summary:
消色差透鏡的歷史早於近代光學產業；這裡選擇的是現代精密光學供應與教育的代表點，並非發明地。Edmund Optics 的 Barrington 據點公開列有工程、製造、品保及配送職能，提醒學徒：設計好的光學元件還需要可製造、可測試與可追溯。

Norman Edmund 於 1942 年在 Collingswood 開始販售光學器材，1948 年遷入 Barrington。兩個節點說明光學知識如何透過元件、型錄及工程支援傳播。座標為城鎮代表位置，地圖查詢使用官方地址，不表示每款透鏡都在此生產或可直接入廠。
courses.summaryEn:
Achromats predate the modern optics industry. This site represents precision-optics supply and education rather than invention. Edmund Optics lists engineering, manufacturing, quality and distribution functions in Barrington, reminding learners that an optical design also needs manufacturability, testability and traceability.

Norman Edmund began selling optics in Collingswood in 1942, and the business moved to Barrington in 1948. These milestones illustrate dissemination through components, catalogs and engineering support. Coordinates represent the town and map lookup uses the official address; production of every lens and public factory access are not implied.

history.title: 開始現地施工
history.text: 跨海工事需要把結構計畫與海峽條件一起安排。
history.textEn: Marine works required coordination between structural planning and strait conditions.

history.title: 地震後重新複核幾何
history.text: 調查發現跨距改變，尚未製作的梁段幾何隨之複核。
history.textEn: Investigation found changed spans, prompting review of geometry for unfabricated girder sections.

history.text: 工程轉入使用與長期檢查階段，主纜防蝕成為持續維護主題之一。

courses.summary:
連接神戶舞子與淡路島的明石海峽大橋，在1988年開始現地施工、1998年開放交通。強潮流、深水、航道與大跨距使它的故事不只是把橋面吊起來，而是讓地盤、纜索、鋼構與海上作業條件共同成立。

1995年阪神淡路大地震發生時，橋梁仍在施工。營運者的回顧記錄了地震後的調查及跨距變化，並說明如何複核尚未完成構件的幾何。地圖以橋址附近為代表點，非測量控制點；本課程由此練習「基準改變後，哪些介面要重新確認」。
courses.summaryEn:
Linking Maiko in Kobe with Awaji Island, the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge entered on-site construction in 1988 and opened in 1998. Strong currents, deep water, navigation and a long span made the project a coordination problem involving ground, cables, steelwork and marine conditions.

The bridge was still under construction when the 1995 earthquake struck. The operator describes subsequent investigations, changed spans and geometric review of unfinished components. The map marks an approximate bridge reference, not a survey control. The course uses this history to ask which interfaces require review when reference geometry changes.
courses.connection: 把橋址的海峽限制連到選址圖，再追蹤懸索載荷、架設狀態、基準修訂與主纜內部環境。這些是可轉移的工程判讀技能，並非原橋施工圖。
courses.connectionEn: Connect strait constraints to the site map, then follow suspension loads, erection states, reference revisions and the cable environment. These are transferable interpretation skills, not the bridge’s construction drawings.

history.text: 服務隧道施工是兩岸逐步接近的重要一環。

history.title: 隧道正式揭幕
history.text: 5月6日的開幕標誌土建工程走向跨國交通系統的營運階段。
history.textEn: The 6 May inauguration marked the transition from construction to an operating cross-border transport system.

courses.summary:
英法海底隧道的故事，是讓兩岸測量、地質判讀與地下施工在海底接合。Getlink的歷史紀錄將英國側服務隧道開挖列於1987年，並記下1990年的首次海底貫通及1994年的開幕。

永久系統由兩條行車隧道和中央服務隧道組成，還需通風、排水、供電及維護交通才能提供服務。地圖使用營運者公布的英國端站座標，作為跨國系統的一個可辨識端點；它不是海底所有設施的位置，也不是施工入口指引。
courses.summaryEn:
The Channel Tunnel joined surveys, geological interpretation and underground construction from two shores. Getlink’s history records service-tunnel boring from Britain in 1987, the first undersea breakthrough in 1990 and inauguration in 1994.

The permanent system includes two running tunnels and a central service tunnel, supported by ventilation, drainage, power and maintenance transport. The map uses the operator’s published UK-terminal coordinates as one identifiable endpoint of a cross-border system. It does not locate every undersea facility or provide construction access directions.
courses.connection: 由端站理解系統邊界，再回到地下剖面檢查地層推論、襯砌、水路與三隧道功能。重點是讓土建與機電證據共用位置及狀態。
courses.connectionEn: Use the terminal to understand system boundaries, then review ground inference, lining, water routes and three-bore functions. The key is reconciling civil and service evidence by location and state.

history.text: 永久壩體之前，需先建立交通、導流及作業條件。

history.text: 分塊與冷卻把材料成熟和整體接合作為相依工作。
history.textEn: Blocks and cooling made material development and integration interdependent tasks.

history.title: 壩體混凝土澆置完成
history.text: 結構成形後仍需區分附屬工程、功能驗證與營運紀錄。
history.textEn: Structural completion still leaves associated works, functional verification and operating records to distinguish.

courses.summary:
胡佛壩位於科羅拉多河黑峽谷，工程把河流導引、岩體支承與大體積混凝土整合在同一狹窄場址。1931年起的施工先要創造能施作壩基的條件；1933年開始的壩體混凝土作業，又把熱與收縮變成重要的工序問題。

1935年壩體混凝土完成，後續仍有機電與附屬工程。這段歷史適合用來理解：完工不是一個所有功能同時成立的瞬間。地圖採用美國墾務局公布的壩址座標；課程中的熱曲線、水路及檢核表是原創示意，並非真實壩體的操作或安全評估。
courses.summaryEn:
Hoover Dam occupies Black Canyon on the Colorado River, combining diversion, rock support and mass concrete at one constrained site. Construction beginning in 1931 first had to create workable foundation conditions. Dam-concrete placement beginning in 1933 made heat and contraction major sequence questions.

Dam-concrete placement finished in 1935, with power and associated works forming further parts of completion. This history shows why completion is not one instant when every function becomes established. The map uses Bureau of Reclamation dam coordinates; course thermal curves, water routes and review sheets are original teaching models, not operating instructions or a safety assessment.
courses.connection: 從黑峽谷追蹤水與力的兩種路徑，再用分塊、冷卻及接縫說明工序依賴。以監測和侵蝕案例練習把損傷現象與成因假說分開。
courses.connectionEn: Trace separate water and force paths through Black Canyon, then use blocks, cooling and joints to examine dependencies. Monitoring and erosion cases teach separation of observed damage from causal hypotheses.

history.text: 工程與營運文物成為理解跨專業合作的公共教材。
history.textEn: Construction and operating artifacts became public material for understanding multidisciplinary collaboration.

courses.summary:
台灣高鐵在2007年開始營運，把跨區域移動變成土建、軌道、列車、電力與控制必須共同完成的服務。工程留下的材料與紀錄，也成為理解技術整合的歷史證據。

2017年於桃園啟用的現址探索館把興建與營運故事放進公共展示；地圖採用政府觀光資料中的館址座標，作為整條鐵路的教學代表點，並非所有維修與建造工作所在地。官網目前有改裝暫停參觀公告，開放狀態請以館方最新公告為準；本課程可直接用公開展覽內容學習。
courses.summaryEn:
Taiwan High Speed Rail began operating in 2007, turning regional travel into a service requiring coordinated civil works, track, trains, power and control. Preserved materials and records also provide historical evidence of that integration.

The museum’s Taoyuan location opened in 2017 presents construction and operating history. The map uses its government-published coordinates as a learning reference for the railway, not the location of every maintenance or construction activity. The official site currently carries a renovation closure notice; consult the museum’s latest announcement for access. This course can be studied through public exhibition information.
courses.connection: 由探索館的軌道與土建展示，延伸到支承、集電、ATC與災害偵測介面。練習區分單機合格、系統相容和營運授權三種證據。
courses.connectionEn: Extend the museum’s track and civil exhibits into support, current collection, ATC and hazard-detection interfaces. Distinguish component acceptance, system compatibility and operating authorization.

history.title: 勿洛歷史場址關閉
history.text: 7月底關閉的廠與中心，留下再生水技術及公眾教育的歷史。
history.textEn: Closure at the end of July left a history of water-reuse technology and public education.

courses.summary:
NEWater的工程故事從再生水可行性研究走到示範與全尺度驗證。PUB在2000年設置示範廠，2003年啟用首兩座新生水廠與訪客中心，讓膜分離和紫外線處理也成為公眾能理解的水循環故事。

勿洛新生水廠與訪客中心於2024年7月底關閉；這裡保留為歷史場址，不是參觀或現役生產的承諾。地圖採用新加坡國家文物局館址地圖的座標。課程由這個地點連到多重屏障、品質追溯及工業與間接飲用回用的不同邊界，而不是把全國供水系統縮成一座廠。
courses.summaryEn:
NEWater progressed from feasibility research to demonstration and full-scale verification. PUB commissioned a demonstration plant in 2000 and opened its first two NEWater plants and visitor centre in 2003, making membranes and ultraviolet treatment part of a public water-cycle story.

The Bedok factory and visitor centre closed at the end of July 2024. This is a historical location, not a promise of visitor access or current production. Coordinates come from the National Heritage Board’s location map. The course connects the site with multiple barriers, quality traceability and different industrial and indirect-potable boundaries rather than representing the national system as one factory.
courses.connection: 沿著MF/UF、RO與UV分辨粒子控制、分離與失活，再檢查濃縮水、採樣與使用端需求。理解「典型值」不能替代特定樣品的驗證。
courses.connectionEn: Follow MF/UF, RO and UV to distinguish particle control, separation and inactivation, then examine concentrate, sampling and destination needs. Learn why typical values do not verify an individual sample.

history.textEn: WHOI records Alvin’s commissioning on 5 June 1964. Its progression from early tests toward scientific use invites learners to distinguish delivery, verification and research outcomes.

history.title: 升級後完成科學驗證

history.textEn: In 2022 WHOI reported science verification after an upgrade, checking whether tools and data collection supported research. This addresses a different layer from establishing an individual structure or device works.

courses.connectionEn: Transfer data identity and tool-interface concepts to cable-route surveys, harbor measurement and environmental monitoring, while reassessing platform and environmental conditions.

courses.summary: Prius讓動力系統的協調成為可以日常觀察的工程問題。豐田會館是這門課的教育地點，並非整車製造廠或所有Prius工序所在地；地圖座標採概略定位。
courses.summaryEn: The Prius makes coordinated power systems an engineering question encountered in everyday life. Toyota Kaikan Museum is this course’s educational location, not a vehicle factory or the site of every Prius operation; map coordinates are approximate.

history.title: 第一代Prius推出
history.text: Toyota公開回顧將第一代Prius的推出記為1997年。它讓引擎、電機與儲能的協同控制成為量產乘用車的重要整合課題。
history.textEn: Toyota’s public account dates the first Prius launch to 1997. It made coordination among engine, electrical machines and stored energy an important integration problem for production passenger vehicles.

history.title: THS II世代發表
history.text: 2003年Toyota發表搭載THS II的新一代Prius。工程原理可延續，但硬體與控制實作仍需依世代查證，不能把所有資料合成一套固定規格。
history.textEn: In 2003 Toyota announced a new Prius with THS II. Principles can persist while hardware and controls evolve, so generation-specific facts must not be combined into one fixed specification.

courses.connection: 油電車的能量帳可以連到捷運回生、儲能站與建築能源管理；每個領域仍有不同的功率尺度、使用周期及安全條件。
courses.connectionEn: Hybrid energy balances connect to regenerative rail systems, storage stations and building energy management, each with different power scales, duty cycles and safety conditions.

references.title: 豐田混合動力系統公開介紹
references.titleEn: Toyota Introduces New Passenger Vehicle Hybrid System
references.scope: 支援1997年公開的引擎、馬達、發電機與功率分流架構。課堂能量帳與故障情境為原創簡化模型，不是ECU標定或維修規格。
references.scopeEn: Supports the engine, motor, generator and power-split architecture publicly described in 1997. Classroom energy balances and fault scenarios are original simplified models, not ECU calibrations or repair specifications.

references.title: 2003年新一代Prius發表
references.scope: 支援1997年首代Prius及2003年THS II世代的歷史；不同年份與市場規格不可混用。
references.scopeEn: Supports the history of the first Prius in 1997 and the THS II generation in 2003; model years and market specifications must remain distinct.

references.title: 豐田會館所在地
references.scope: 僅支援豐田會館在愛知縣豐田市的代表性教育地點；不代表Prius全部工序在館內製造。
references.scopeEn: Supports the representative educational location of Toyota Kaikan Museum in Toyota City, Aichi; does not imply Prius production occurs in the museum.

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: Landsat不只是在太空拍照，也是一條包含地面接收、處理、校準與保存的資料鏈。EROS代表這條鏈在地面的重要角色，不代表衛星當前位置或發射場；座標為中心周邊概略定位。
courses.summaryEn: Landsat is not only imaging from space; it is a chain of reception, processing, calibration and preservation. EROS represents an important ground role, not a satellite’s current position or a launch site; coordinates approximately locate the center area.

history.title: ERTS-1開啟長期地表觀測
history.titleEn: ERTS-1 begins a long Earth-observation record
history.text: 1972年7月23日，後來改稱Landsat 1的ERTS-1發射。USGS的EROS歷史也記錄了早期影像處理的困難：有訊號，仍需處理成可研究的資料。
history.textEn: ERTS-1, later renamed Landsat 1, launched on 23 July 1972. USGS’s EROS history also records early image-processing difficulties: receiving a signal still required turning it into usable research data.

history.title: Landsat 8延續觀測任務
history.text: 2013年2月11日Landsat 8發射，搭載OLI與TIRS。長期計畫加入新儀器時，延續資料可比性與辨識世代差異同樣重要。
history.textEn: Landsat 8 launched on 11 February 2013 with OLI and TIRS. Adding instruments to a long-running program makes continuity and recognition of generational differences equally important.

courses.connection: 可以把遥測證據鏈帶到水庫、海岸、農地與城市變遷研究；地面工程判斷仍需結合現場量測與適當尺度。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the remote-sensing evidence chain to reservoir, coastal, agricultural and urban-change studies; ground engineering decisions still require field measurements and appropriate scale.

references.title: EROS中心歷史
references.scope: 支援1972年ERTS-1／Landsat 1發射與蘇瀑地面資料處理的歷史，及EROS作為地面資料中心的地理角色。
references.scopeEn: Supports the 1972 ERTS-1/Landsat 1 launch and Sioux Falls data-processing history, and EROS’s geographic role as a ground data center.

references.title: Landsat 8儀器與軌道
references.scope: 支援Landsat 8觀测波段、軌道週期、重訪及2013年發射背景；不得將一代衛星規格套到整個計畫。
references.scopeEn: Supports Landsat 8 bands, orbital period, repeat cycle and its 2013 launch; one satellite generation’s specifications must not be applied to the entire program.

place.name: 歐登塞機器人聚落（城市代表位置）
place.nameEn: Odense robotics cluster — representative city location
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: UR5的公開歷史與丹麥歐登塞的機器人研究聚落相連。這裡用城市代表產學與整合生態，不把地圖點當成工廠入口；課程聚焦可轉移的座標與應用驗證觀念。
courses.summaryEn: The UR5’s public history is connected to the robotics research cluster in Odense, Denmark. A city marker represents that research and integration ecosystem, not a factory entrance. The course focuses on transferable coordinate and application-validation concepts.

history.title: Universal Robots創立
history.text: 官方歷史記載公司於2005年創立，目標之一是讓較小型企業也能使用可重新配置的機器人。這將技術問題帶向示教、整合與操作可理解性。
history.textEn: The official history dates the company’s founding to 2005, with a goal of making reconfigurable robots accessible to smaller businesses. This connects engineering to teaching interfaces, integration and understandable operation.

history.title: UR5產品推出
history.text: 2008年UR5成為公司的首項產品。機器人從單一機械手臂走入不同工作站時，工具、工件與人員情境都要重新納入應用評估。
history.textEn: In 2008 the UR5 became the company’s first product. As one arm enters different workcells, tools, parts and human-use scenarios must each be reconsidered in the application assessment.

courses.connection: 相同的座標框與配置管理觀念可用於量測機、數控設備及大型構件定位；可達性與安全要求仍隨設備改變。
courses.connectionEn: The same frame and configuration-control concepts apply to measuring machines, CNC equipment and large-component positioning, while reachability and safety requirements remain equipment-specific.

references.title: Universal Robots歷史
references.scope: 支援2005年創立、2008年UR5產品推出的歷史。課程保留UR5目錄名稱，技術例子以一般六軸座標原理為主。
references.scopeEn: Supports founding in 2005 and the UR5 launch in 2008. The course preserves the UR5 catalog title while technical examples emphasize general six-axis coordinate principles.

references.title: Universal Robots與歐登塞機器人聚落
references.titleEn: Universal Robots and the Odense robotics cluster
references.scope: 僅使用公開文章中的歐登塞總部、研究聚落與創立背景；不沿用舊文的市場數字或管理人員任職狀態。
references.scopeEn: Uses the article’s public Odense headquarters, research-cluster and founding background only; does not repeat outdated market figures or executive status.

place.city: 伊瓜蘇市／埃爾南達里亞斯

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: 伊泰普位於巴拉那河的巴西與巴拉圭交界。1973 年的條約與 1984 年開始發電，顯示大型機電工程同時需要長期制度安排與分期整合。地圖為大壩的概略代表點，不是施工入口或機組座標。
courses.summaryEn: Itaipu sits on the Paraná River between Brazil and Paraguay. The 1973 treaty and start of generation in 1984 show how a major electromechanical project combines institutional arrangements with staged integration. The map is an approximate dam reference point, not a construction entrance or unit coordinate.

history.title: 簽署伊泰普條約
history.text: 巴西與巴拉圭以條約建立共同開發水力資源的框架。
history.textEn: Brazil and Paraguay established a treaty framework for joint hydropower development.

history.title: 開始發電
history.text: 伊泰普於五月開始發電，電站由建設轉入分期機組運轉。
history.textEn: Itaipu began generating in May as construction transitioned into staged unit operation.

courses.connection: 在地圖辨識跨境水體，再以課程圖分清水量、軸功率與兩國電氣介面。
courses.connectionEn: Locate the cross-border water resource, then separate water balance, shaft power and national-grid interfaces.

references.title: 伊泰普公開資訊：成立與啟用
references.titleEn: Itaipu public information: founding and operation
references.scope: 支援 1973 年條約、1974 年公司成立、1984 年發電的歷史背景；不提供本課程的假設數值。
references.scopeEn: Supports treaty, company and generation milestones in 1973, 1974 and 1984; does not supply the course’s assumed numbers.

references.title: 伊泰普電站與發電機組
references.titleEn: Itaipu power plant and generating units
references.scope: 支援電站規模與 50/60 Hz 機組分組；年度產量須帶年份閱讀，不作固定保證。
references.scopeEn: Supports plant scale and 50/60 Hz unit groups; annual output is dated information, not a guaranteed constant.

references.title: 水力發電如何運作
references.scope: 支援水頭、流量、水輪機及發電機的通用原理；教學計算不代表伊泰普實際操作設定。
references.scopeEn: Supports general head, flow, turbine and generator principles; teaching calculations are not Itaipu operating settings.

place.name: 呂勒奧 HYBRIT 試驗工程（城市代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: 呂勒奧是 HYBRIT 直接還原與儲氫試驗的代表城市。地圖以城市概略點連結課程，不是工業廠入口；耶利瓦勒的工業示範規劃另屬不同地點。
courses.summaryEn: Luleå represents HYBRIT’s direct-reduction and hydrogen-storage pilots. The approximate city marker connects the course to its setting, not a plant entrance; the Gällivare industrial-demonstration plan is a separate location.

history.title: HYBRIT 合作啟動
history.text: SSAB、LKAB 與 Vattenfall 啟動合作，研究以氫取代傳統還原路徑中的化石燃料。
history.textEn: SSAB, LKAB and Vattenfall began collaborating on replacing fossil fuels in conventional reduction routes with hydrogen.

history.title: 呂勒奧還原試驗設施啟用
history.text: 八月啟用的試驗設施為氫直接還原提供公開案例；它不是整座商業鋼廠。
history.textEn: The pilot inaugurated in August provides a public hydrogen-reduction case; it is not a complete commercial steelworks.

history.title: 儲氫試驗進入運作
history.text: 呂勒奧儲氫試驗於夏季投入運作，將儲存與製氫、還原需求的時間介面納入驗證。
history.textEn: The Luleå storage pilot entered operation in summer, adding evidence on timing interfaces between storage, hydrogen production and reduction demand.

courses.connection: 先辨識試驗所在城市，再以課程分清「已驗證的單元」與「仍需放大的整合證據」。
courses.connectionEn: Locate the pilot city, then distinguish demonstrated units from integration evidence still needed at larger scale.

references.title: HYBRIT 事實與里程碑
references.scope: 支援呂勒奧試驗設施與耶利瓦勒工業示範規劃的區分，以及 2016、2020、2022 年事件。
references.scopeEn: Supports the distinction between Luleå pilots and the planned Gällivare industrial demonstration, and milestones in 2016, 2020 and 2022.

references.title: 氫氣直接還原試驗
references.scope: 支援鐵礦球團、直接還原、海綿鐵、電解與水循環的公開原理；不含設備配方。
references.scopeEn: Supports public principles of pellets, direct reduction, sponge iron, electrolysis and water circulation; not equipment recipes.

references.title: HYBRIT 儲氫試驗
references.scope: 支援儲氫與電力、還原工序的系統介面；本課不提供壓力操作或氫氣設備建造指示。
references.scopeEn: Supports storage interfaces with electricity and reduction; the course gives no pressure operating or hydrogen equipment construction instructions.

place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: 以倫敦科學博物館代表 EMI 早期 CT 設備的典藏脈絡。1971 年安裝地為溫布頓 Atkinson Morley 醫院，並非這個地圖點；典藏紀錄也不保證目前現場展示。
courses.summaryEn: The Science Museum represents the collection context for the early EMI CT instrument. Its 1971 installation was at Atkinson Morley’s Hospital in Wimbledon, not this map point; the collection record does not guarantee current public display.

history.title: 早期 EMI 掃描器安裝
history.text: Science Museum Group 記錄了早期 EMI 腦部 CT 掃描器於 Atkinson Morley 醫院安裝的歷史。
history.textEn: The Science Museum Group records the early EMI brain CT scanner’s installation at Atkinson Morley’s Hospital.

history.title: 霍恩斯菲爾德說明計算成像
history.text: 十二月八日的諾貝爾演講提供發明者對投影量測與重建思路的第一手說明。
history.textEn: The Nobel Lecture of 8 December provides the inventor’s account of projection measurements and reconstruction ideas.

courses.connection: 地圖連結典藏與發明史；課程用紙上矩陣與數位假體重新建構其中可公開驗證的物理原理。
courses.connectionEn: The map connects collection and invention history; paper matrices and digital phantoms reconstruct the publicly testable physics.

references.title: EMI 腦部 CT 掃描器典藏
references.titleEn: EMI CT Brain Scanner collection record
references.scope: 支援 EMI 早期設備與 1971 年 Atkinson Morley 醫院安裝背景；典藏紀錄不保證目前展示狀態。
references.scopeEn: Supports the early EMI instrument and its 1971 installation at Atkinson Morley’s Hospital; a collection record does not guarantee current display.

references.title: 霍恩斯菲爾德 1979 年諾貝爾演講
references.titleEn: Hounsfield’s 1979 Nobel Lecture: Computed Medical Imaging
references.scope: 發明者對多角度衰減量測及重建的第一手說明；本課僅做無輻射的數位幾何實驗。
references.scopeEn: First-person account of multi-angle attenuation measurement and reconstruction; this course uses radiation-free digital geometry only.

references.title: CT 品質保證：IAEA Human Health Series 19
references.titleEn: Quality Assurance Programme for Computed Tomography, IAEA HHS 19
references.scope: 僅支援影像物理、假體量測及品質追溯概念；不轉載臨床操作、診斷或治療流程。
references.scopeEn: Supports image physics, phantom measurement and quality traceability concepts only; no clinical, diagnostic or treatment procedures are reproduced.

place.name: 卡倫堡工業共生（城市／產業群代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: 卡倫堡共生是跨企業與公共部門逐步形成的交換網路，不是單一工廠。地圖標示城市與產業群的概略位置，不表示管線路徑、企業入口或目前所有成員。
courses.summaryEn: Kalundborg Symbiosis is a gradually developed exchange network involving firms and public bodies, not one factory. The marker approximates the city and industrial cluster, not pipeline routes, company entrances or all current members.

history.title: 地表水供應連接形成
history.text: 官方促進指南記述，從 Tissø 湖向煉油設施供水的連接，成為後來共生網路的早期背景。
history.textEn: The official facilitator guide describes a Lake Tissø water connection to the refinery as an early antecedent of the later symbiosis network.

history.title: 共生秘書處成立
history.text: 秘書處的成立使交流與協調有了持續的組織支援，顯示治理也是工程系統的一部分。
history.textEn: Establishing the secretariat provided continuing organizational support for exchange and coordination, showing that governance is part of the engineering system.

courses.connection: 地圖提供合作發生的地理背景；課程以匿名教學網路練習資源適配、計量邊界與共同證據。
courses.connectionEn: The map supplies the geographic context of cooperation; an anonymous teaching network supports practice in resource fit, metering boundaries and shared evidence.

references.title: 卡倫堡工業共生官方介紹
references.scope: 支援跨企業水、能源與物料交換的組織模式；不把動態成員數或減碳值寫成固定工程參數。
references.scopeEn: Supports inter-company water, energy and material exchange; changing member counts or carbon savings are not treated as fixed engineering parameters.

references.title: 卡倫堡共生：合作與歷史
references.scope: 支援實體交換網路與信任、合作的作用；步驟中的合約與異常案例為原創教學情境。
references.scopeEn: Supports physical exchange networks and the role of trust and cooperation; contract and incident cases are original teaching scenarios.

references.title: 工業共生促進指南：卡倫堡案例
references.titleEn: Guide for Industrial Symbiosis Facilitators: Kalundborg case
references.scope: 支援 1961 年供水連接、1996 年秘書處成立與合作治理背景；不提供現行管網操作許可。
references.scopeEn: Supports the 1961 water connection, 1996 secretariat and collaborative governance; not authorization to operate current networks.

place.name: CERN 梅蘭園區（機構代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

courses.summary: LHC 是跨越瑞士與法國邊界的地下環形設施。此點代表 CERN 梅蘭園區的機構背景，不是整個環的中心、實驗碰撞點或地下入口。
courses.summaryEn: The LHC is an underground ring crossing the Swiss–French border. This point represents the institutional setting at CERN’s Meyrin site, not the ring centre, an experimental collision point or an underground entrance.

history.title: LHC 首次啟動
history.text: 九月十日的首次啟動是大型加速器整合史上的重要節點。
history.textEn: The first startup on 10 September marked an important milestone in integrating the large accelerator.

history.title: 希格斯粒子發現里程碑
history.text: ATLAS 與 CMS 的發現是加速器、探測器與分析共同工作的成果；本課不以示意資料重現該發現。
history.textEn: The ATLAS and CMS discovery resulted from combined accelerator, detector and analysis work; this lesson does not reproduce that discovery with illustrative data.

courses.connection: 地圖說明機構與跨境工程背景；課程圖用於理解職責和介面，不能作為現場導航或設備操作圖。
courses.connectionEn: The map explains the institutional and cross-border setting; course diagrams explain responsibilities and interfaces, not site navigation or equipment operations.

references.title: 大型強子對撞機概覽
references.scope: 支援加速器、真空、低溫與探測器的系統概覽，以及 2008、2012 年歷史節點。
references.scopeEn: Supports accelerator, vacuum, cryogenic and detector system context, and historical milestones in 2008 and 2012.

references.title: 超導電磁鐵與束流導引
references.scope: 支援二極、四極與其他磁鐵的角色；頁面歷史運轉數字不作今日設定，課程不含聯鎖繞過。

place.coordinateScope: 約略橋址中心；用於認識海峽位置，不是行人入口、導航目的地或測量控制點。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate bridge-center pin for strait context; not a pedestrian entrance, navigation destination or survey control.

history.title: 海峽工程開始
history.text: 1 月開始建設，工程需把海峽條件與懸索系統一起處理。
history.textEn: Construction began in January, combining strait conditions with a suspension system.

history.title: 開放車輛通行
history.text: 5 月 29 日開放車輛通行，工程轉入長期使用與維護。
history.textEn: The bridge opened to vehicles on 29 May, beginning its operating and maintenance life.

history.title: 橋面更新
history.text: 原混凝土橋面改為較輕的正交異性鋼橋面，是理解既有橋介面改造的案例。
history.textEn: The concrete deck was replaced with a lighter orthotropic steel deck, a case for studying existing-bridge interfaces.

courses.summary: 跨越金門海峽的工程把海上基礎、塔、主纜與端部錨碇串成完整的力路徑。它的歷史也包含橋面與吊索更新，讓學生看見建造後的長期工程工作。
courses.summaryEn: The crossing links marine foundations, towers, main cables and end anchorages into a complete load path. Its history also includes deck and hanger renewal, showing the engineering work that continues after construction.
courses.connection: 可與明石海峽大橋比較主纜吊索系統，再與淡江大橋比較斜張索力路徑；幾何追溯與維護證據可共學，場址與受力參數不能直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare the main-cable and hanger system with Akashi Kaikyo, then contrast Danjiang’s stay-cable force paths. Geometry traceability and maintenance evidence transfer, while site and force parameters do not.

references.scopeEn: Dimension definitions, cables, hangers and displacement cases; vector, tolerance and model-review exercises are original extensions.

history.title: 觀景台對外營運
history.text: 3 月觀景台開始對外營運，也提供觀察阻尼裝置的公共學習場景。
history.textEn: The observatory opened in March and provides a public setting for learning about the damper.

courses.summary: 台北 101 的工程故事不只在高度。結構設計者說明斜撐核心、多層外伸系統與周邊框架；業主則公開阻尼器及設備用途，讓學生把建築外觀、使用需求與動力反應放在同一個模型中。
courses.summaryEn: Taipei 101’s engineering story extends beyond height. The designer describes a braced core, multiple outriggers and perimeter framing, while the owner explains the damper and building services, connecting appearance, use and dynamics.
courses.connection: 與其他超高層比較時，先查核心與周邊的分工，再對比風振控制及設備介面。上海中心與哈里發塔可作延伸研究，不能假定其配置與台北 101 相同。
courses.connectionEn: For other supertalls, first verify core–perimeter roles, then compare wind-motion control and service interfaces. Shanghai Tower and Burj Khalifa are further-study topics whose layouts must not be assumed identical to Taipei 101.

history.text: 瑞士政府資料列出 2016 年投入使用，讓跨阿爾卑斯運輸改用較低高程的基線連結。

courses.summary: 從厄斯特費爾德到博迪奧的基線工程需要在不同岩體中更新地質模型，並把雙管土建、襯砌、防水及鐵路設備接合。課程使用地質與工程師一次文獻作背景，練習把未知條件及介面證據留下來。
courses.summaryEn: The base connection from Erstfeld to Bodio required geological updates across varying ground and integration of twin-tube civil works, lining, water control and railway equipment. Primary geological and engineering sources support exercises in preserving uncertainty and interface evidence.
courses.connection: 可與英法海峽隧道、雪山隧道共同學習地質更新、量測及移交；鐵路、公路、山岳與海底的條件不同，通風、斷面及營運假設須各自查證。
courses.connectionEn: Compare geological updating, measurement and handover with the Channel and Hsuehshan tunnels. Rail, road, mountain and undersea settings differ, so ventilation, cross-section and operating assumptions need separate evidence.

history.title: 首批新閘門到港
history.text: 8 月首批四座滾動閘門抵達巴拿馬，顯示大型水工也依賴跨國製造與運輸介面。
history.textEn: The first four rolling gates arrived in August, illustrating international fabrication and transport interfaces.

history.title: 節水池充水測試
history.text: 運河管理局宣布首座節水池充水並展開水密相關測試。
history.textEn: The Canal Authority announced the first basin filling and associated watertightness testing.

history.title: 擴建運河啟用
history.text: 6 月 26 日擴建運河啟用，科科利與阿瓜克拉拉成為新增船閘通道。
history.textEn: The expanded canal was inaugurated on 26 June, adding the Cocolí and Agua Clara lock route.

courses.summary: 擴建船閘讓船舶在海洋與加通湖之間通過新的閘室系統。滾動閘門、節水池、巨量土建及水力控制需要共同成立；淡水同時服務通航與流域需求，因此水量邊界是這個故事的核心。
courses.summaryEn: The expanded locks provide a new chamber system between the oceans and Gatun Lake. Rolling gates, saving basins, major civil works and hydraulic control must function together; shared freshwater needs make water-accounting boundaries central to the story.
courses.connection: 先與原巴拿馬運河比較人字門和滾動門，再延伸到三峽船閘與升船機。共同問題是升降船舶與服務連續性；水力調節和機械升降的承載與能源路徑不同。
courses.connectionEn: First contrast miter and rolling gates with the original Panama Canal, then study Three Gorges locks and its ship lift. Vessel elevation and service continuity are shared questions, while hydraulic adjustment and mechanical lifting have different load and energy paths.

place.name: imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）
place.nameEn: imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference
place.coordinateScope: 官方聯絡頁所嵌入地圖的 Tower 園區代表點；不是製程設備或晶圓加工座標，也不表示可自由進入。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Tower campus reference from the map embedded by the official contact page; not process-equipment coordinates or unrestricted access.

courses.summary:
imec 的魯汶園區是背面供電公開研究的重要地點之一。背面供電把電源與訊號配線分工重新安排，需要同時處理鍵合、薄化、對準、接觸及熱路徑。此課程以公開研究作為技術對話的入口，而不是複製 imec 的內部流程。

地圖定位官方列示的 imec Tower 訪客地址，座標取自官方聯絡頁嵌入的地圖。背面供電由多家研究機構與企業發展；此點不代表唯一發明地，也不揭示實際試驗設備位置。
courses.summaryEn:
imec’s Leuven campus is one important location for public backside-power research. Separating power and signal routing connects bonding, thinning, alignment, contacts and thermal paths. This course uses public research for technical discussion without reproducing an internal imec flow.

The map identifies the officially listed imec Tower visitor address, using the map embedded on the official contact page. Multiple institutions and companies develop backside power; this point is neither an exclusive invention claim nor a location of experimental equipment.

history.title: imec 在魯汶開始發展
history.text: 官方總部介紹將魯汶列為 1984 年故事的起點。
history.textEn: The official headquarters page identifies Leuven as where imec began in 1984.

history.title: 公開展示埋藏軌的背面連接
history.text: imec 公布以背面通孔連到埋藏電源軌的研究展示，並報告測試元件的電性評估。
history.textEn: imec published a backside-via/buried-rail demonstration with electrical evaluation of its test devices.

courses.connection: 可接續晶圓薄化、混合鍵合與先進封裝：共同問題是介面平坦度、對準及接觸電阻；不同點是電源、訊號與機械支撐的目標。
courses.connectionEn: Continue to wafer thinning, hybrid bonding and advanced packaging: shared questions include flatness, alignment and contact resistance, while power, signal and mechanical objectives differ.

place.name: ASML Veldhoven 園區（High-NA 研究代表地）
place.nameEn: ASML Veldhoven campus: High-NA reference location
place.coordinateScope: 荷蘭 BAG 地址資料的園區建物代表座標，四捨五入顯示；不是聯合實驗室入口或房間座標。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Rounded campus address-object coordinate from Dutch BAG data; not the joint-lab entrance or room.

courses.summary:
ASML 與 imec 於 2024 年宣布在 Veldhoven 開放共同運作的 High-NA EUV 實驗室，將掃描機、塗佈顯影與量測環境放在同一整合問題中。更高數值孔徑帶來更細解析度，也讓焦深、薄光阻及場接縫的取捨更關鍵。

此地圖使用 ASML 官方總部地址；座標以荷蘭官方 PDOK/BAG 地址資料核對，僅代表園區。它不是實驗室房間定位，也不表示園區對一般參觀者開放。
courses.summaryEn:
ASML and imec announced their jointly operated High-NA EUV laboratory in Veldhoven in 2024, linking the scanner with coating, development and metrology. Higher numerical aperture improves resolution while tightening depth-of-focus, thin-resist and stitching tradeoffs.

The map uses ASML’s official headquarters address, checked against Dutch PDOK/BAG address data as a campus reference. It does not locate a laboratory room or imply unrestricted visitor access.

history.title: 啟動共同準備工作
history.text: 2024 年聯合公告追溯掃描機及周邊技術準備工作自 2018 年展開。
history.textEn: The 2024 joint announcement traces scanner and ecosystem preparations to 2018.

history.title: 聯合 High-NA EUV 實驗室開幕
history.text: ASML 與 imec 宣布 Veldhoven 實驗室開放，作為研究與產業提前驗證的平台。
history.textEn: ASML and imec announced the Veldhoven lab opening as a platform for early research and industrial validation.

courses.connection: 可接續一般 EUV 光刻機、消色差光學與半導體圖案轉移：都需管理波前、幾何及量測；EUV 主要使用反射鏡，不能直接套用可見光透鏡製作流程。

history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.

history.title: 跨元件與封裝的共同驗證
history.text: 相同光學性能需在固定、溫變與電性連接之後重新檢查；原始研究結果與量產資格是不同證據層級。
history.textEn: Recheck optical behavior after attachment, temperature change and electrical connection; research results and production qualification are different evidence levels.

courses.summary: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合以晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration links device physics and system validation through crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 晶圓尺度轉印展示
history.text: Ghent University / Optics Letters 的「200 mm 矽光子晶圓的鈮酸鋰微轉印實驗」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Ghent University / Optics Letters: Lithium-niobate transfer printing on a 200-mm silicon photonics wafer provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.

courses.summary: 光子封裝熱機耦合分析以熱場、翹曲、界面和光模式的耦合連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。

history.textEn: Ansys publicly demonstrates transferring temperature fields to an optical solver. This course independently compares geometry and material perturbations in a hypothetical package; that example does not validate a particular package.

history.textEn: Dickmann and colleagues measured silicon photoelastic response at 1550 nm with temperature and orientation dependence. This course separates material evidence from mode overlap and geometric path length.

history.text: 公開熱調波導模型說明溫度也會改變光學結果。本課據此安排固定溫度的應力對照，避免將所有相位漂移都歸因於光彈效應。
history.textEn: The public thermally tuned waveguide model shows temperature also changes optical response. The course therefore adds constant-temperature stress comparisons instead of assigning all phase drift to photoelasticity.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據

history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：短脈衝溫升取決於 Zθ(t)，不是只靠穩態 Rθ。 以「比較相同平均功率、不同占空比的峰值溫度。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。

history.text: Texas Instruments 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。聲速隨介質和環境改變，不可把空氣值用於液體。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「聲電諧振、回波與飛行時間」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Texas Instruments provides a traceable starting point. Sound speed changes with medium/environment; air values do not apply to liquids. Independently authored models connect this to electroacoustic resonance, echoes and time of flight; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：較晚回波可能更弱，增益曲線需兼顧近距飽和。 以「比較固定增益與時變增益下的回波序列。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Later echoes may be weaker; gain profiles must also avoid near saturation. Practice interpretation using: Compare echo trains with fixed and time-varying gain. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ASML 微影投影光學工程
history.text: 1980 年代的步進機以全折射 g-line 與 i-line 鏡頭成像，1990 年代步進掃描機以縫隙掃描把視場擴大到 26×33 mm；ASML 與蔡司在 2000 年代把 ArF 鏡頭推進到折反射浸潤架構，NA 1.35 的 TWINSCAN NXT 系列從 2007 年前後成為先進製程主力，之後由 13.5 nm 的 NXE 與 NA 0.55 的 High-NA EXE 接續。Nikon 與 Canon 也各自發展浸潤與 i-line 投影鏡頭。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何專有設計。
history.textEn: Steppers of the 1980s imaged with all-refractive g-line and i-line lenses, and 1990s step-and-scan systems enlarged the field to 26×33 mm by scanning a slit; ASML and ZEISS advanced ArF lenses to catadioptric immersion layouts in the 2000s, and the NA 1.35 TWINSCAN NXT series became the workhorse of advanced nodes from around 2007, later joined by the 13.5 nm NXE and the NA 0.55 High-NA EXE. Nikon and Canon developed their own immersion and i-line projection lenses. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only, not any proprietary design.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「Rayleigh 解析度與景深的系統邊界」到「系統成像驗證、套刻預算與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Rayleigh resolution and depth-of-focus system boundaries" through "System imaging validation, overlay budget and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
history.text: 1980 年代 Barbee 等人證明 Mo/Si 多層膜可在軟 X 光波段達到高反射率，使 13.5 nm 反射式微影成為可能；ZEISS 與 ASML 合作的 EUV 投影光學於 2010 年代進入量產微影機，近年的 High-NA EUV 更把數值孔徑提升到 0.55，鏡面尺寸與面形要求再提高一級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何專有膜系配方。
history.textEn: In the 1980s Barbee and colleagues showed that Mo/Si multilayers reach high soft-X-ray reflectance, making reflective lithography at 13.5 nm feasible; EUV projection optics developed by ZEISS with ASML entered production lithography tools in the 2010s, and recent High-NA EUV raised the numerical aperture to 0.55 with larger mirrors and tighter figure. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic, not any proprietary coating recipe.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: EUV 光源錫滴控制概念
history.text: 雷射電漿 EUV 光源的工程化由聖地牙哥的 Cymer（1986 年成立，2013 年併入 ASML）與日本 Gigaphoton 在 2000 年代推動，TRUMPF 與 Cymer 合作把多級 CO₂ 放大器的平均功率推到數十千瓦；前脈衝靶形技術與氫氣清潔使 IF 功率從 2010 年代初的數十瓦提升到 2017 年前後的 250 W，之後持續朝 500 W 以上推進，支撐 NXE 系列進入量產。本課只重建公開文獻中的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Engineering of laser-produced-plasma EUV sources was driven in the 2000s by Cymer of San Diego (founded 1986, acquired by ASML in 2013) and by Gigaphoton in Japan, with TRUMPF and Cymer pushing multi-stage CO₂ amplifiers to tens of kilowatts of average power; pre-pulse target shaping and hydrogen cleaning raised IF power from tens of watts in the early 2010s to about 250 W around 2017 and onward toward 500 W and more, supporting NXE systems in volume production. This course reconstructs only the physics and engineering logic found in public literature.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 微影晶圓台精密定位
history.titleEn: Precision positioning of lithography wafer stages
history.text: 1980 年代的步進機以氣浮載台與 HeNe 雷射干涉儀達到次微米定位，1990 年代步進掃描機要求光罩台與晶圓台同步運動，使 MA/MSD 成為標準規格；ASML 在 2001 年推出雙晶圓台的 TWINSCAN，把量測與曝光分開進行，2000 年代末期的 NXT 系列改用光柵編碼器量測與平衡質量，EUV 的 NXE 系列在真空中採用磁浮平面馬達載台。這些架構的公開原理可在 ASML 與編碼器廠商的技術文件中找到，本課不涉及任何專有控制參數。
history.textEn: Steppers of the 1980s reached sub-micrometre positioning with air-bearing stages and HeNe laser interferometers; 1990s step-and-scan tools required synchronised reticle and wafer motion, making MA/MSD a standard specification. ASML introduced the dual-wafer-stage TWINSCAN in 2001 to separate measurement from exposure, the NXT series of the late 2000s moved to grating-encoder metrology and balance masses, and the EUV NXE series uses magnetically levitated planar-motor stages in vacuum. The public principles of these architectures appear in ASML and encoder-maker technical documents; this course involves no proprietary control parameters.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 複消色差顯微物鏡
history.text: 恩斯特·阿貝在 1886 年與奧托·肖特合作，利用耶拿新研製的玻璃與螢石推出第一批複消色差物鏡，「apochromat」一詞也由阿貝提出；20 世紀中葉平場複消色差（Plan-Apo）解決場曲問題，1990 年代各廠轉向無限遠校正系統並把橫向色差校正納入物鏡本體，使 ZEISS、Nikon、Olympus（今 Evident）與 Leica 的物鏡成為共軛焦與超解析顯微術的基礎。本課只重建公開的光學原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Ernst Abbe, working with Otto Schott, introduced the first apochromatic objectives in 1886 using newly developed Jena glasses and fluorite, and Abbe coined the term apochromat; mid-20th-century plan-apochromats solved field curvature, and in the 1990s makers moved to infinity-corrected systems with lateral colour corrected inside the objective, making ZEISS, Nikon, Olympus (now Evident) and Leica objectives the foundation of confocal and super-resolution microscopy. This course reconstructs only public optical principles and engineering methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 非球面光學加工
history.text: 笛卡兒在 1637 年已描述能消球差的非球面，但長期無法加工；1930 年施密特以真空變形法做出施密特校正板，1960 年代美國實驗室與機床廠發展出單點鑽石車削，1970 年代電腦全像片開始用於非球面零位測試，1980 年代起精密玻璃模造讓小口徑玻璃非球面進入量產，1990 年代羅徹斯特發展的磁流變拋光把確定性修形帶入工業。今天從智慧型手機的塑膠非球面到微影鏡頭的大型非球面都依賴這些方法。本課只重建公開的工程原理。
history.textEn: Descartes described spherical-aberration-free aspheric surfaces as early as 1637, but they remained unmanufacturable for centuries; Schmidt made his corrector plate by vacuum deformation in 1930, single-point diamond turning emerged from US laboratories and machine builders in the 1960s, computer-generated holograms entered aspheric null testing in the 1970s, precision glass molding brought small glass aspheres into volume production from the 1980s, and magnetorheological finishing developed in Rochester in the 1990s brought deterministic figuring to industry. Today everything from plastic smartphone aspheres to large lithography aspheres relies on these methods. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 自由曲面光學量測
history.text: 電腦全像片零位測試在 1970 年代由 Wyant 等人建立，使非球面與離軸面能用干涉儀驗收；2000 年代鑽石車削的慢刀伺服與確定性拋光讓自由曲面可以製造，量測成為瓶頸，於是出現 QED 的次口徑拼接干涉儀、斯圖加特大學 ITO 發展的傾斜波干涉儀與 PTB 的可追溯非球面量測；2013 年美國 NSF 支持羅徹斯特大學與北卡羅來納大學夏洛特分校成立自由曲面光學中心（CeFO），2015 年 ISO 10110-19 訂定自由曲面的規格標示方式。本課只整理公開的量測原理。
history.textEn: Computer-generated-hologram null testing was established by Wyant and colleagues in the 1970s, allowing aspheres and off-axis surfaces to be accepted interferometrically; in the 2000s slow-tool-servo diamond turning and deterministic polishing made freeforms manufacturable and metrology became the bottleneck, prompting QED's subaperture stitching interferometer, the tilted-wave interferometer developed at ITO University of Stuttgart and traceable asphere metrology at PTB; in 2013 the US NSF supported the University of Rochester and UNC Charlotte in founding the Center for Freeform Optics (CeFO), and in 2015 ISO 10110-19 defined how freeform surfaces are specified. This course compiles only public metrology principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學玻璃精密退火
history.text: 夫朗和斐在 19 世紀初就發現條紋與應力限制了光學玻璃的品質；1884 年奧托·肖特與阿貝、蔡司在耶拿建立系統化的光學玻璃研發，退火成為固定工序；1920 年 Adams 與 Williamson 以黏彈性理論量化退火中的應力鬆弛與永久應力，1946 年 Tool 提出假想溫度概念解釋折射率與熱歷史的關係；之後 SCHOTT、Ohara 與 HOYA 以電腦控制的精密退火爐與分級制度（折射率公差、均勻性、雙折射等級）支撐微影與天文光學對大口徑毛胚的要求。本課只整理公開的物理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Fraunhofer recognised in the early 19th century that striae and stress limited optical-glass quality; in 1884 Otto Schott with Abbe and Zeiss established systematic optical-glass development in Jena with annealing as a fixed process step; in 1920 Adams and Williamson quantified stress relaxation and permanent stress in annealing with viscoelastic theory, and in 1946 Tool introduced the fictive-temperature concept linking refractive index to thermal history; SCHOTT, Ohara and HOYA later used computer-controlled precision annealing furnaces and grading systems (index tolerance, homogeneity and birefringence grades) to meet the large-blank demands of lithography and astronomical optics. This course compiles only public physics and engineering methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 離子束光學表面修形
history.text: 柵極離子源源自 1960 年代 Harold Kaufman 在 NASA 為電推進發展的寬束離子源；1980 年代末新墨西哥大學與 Eastman Kodak 把它用於光學面形修正，Kodak 的離子束修形設備在 1990 年代初為 Keck 望遠鏡的 1.8 m 六角分段鏡完成最終修形，證明這種非接觸、確定性的製程能把大型非球面收斂到數十奈米。此後德國的研究機構與設備商把束寬縮小、把去除函數校正與反卷積軟體標準化，現在 ESO 極大望遠鏡的主鏡分段也在拋光後以離子束做最終修整。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Gridded ion sources descend from the broad-beam sources Harold Kaufman developed at NASA for electric propulsion in the 1960s; in the late 1980s the University of New Mexico and Eastman Kodak applied them to optical figure correction, and Kodak's ion-beam figuring facility finished the 1.8 m hexagonal segments of the Keck telescope in the early 1990s, proving that a non-contact deterministic process can converge large aspheres to tens of nanometres. German research institutes and equipment makers then narrowed the beam and standardised removal-function calibration and deconvolution software, and today the primary-mirror segments of the ESO Extremely Large Telescope receive ion-beam finishing after polishing. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
