history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 磁流變光學拋光
history.text: 磁流變拋光的概念由 William Kordonski 與同事在 1980 年代末於明斯克提出，1990 年代在羅徹斯特大學光學製造中心由 Jacobs、Golini 與 Kordonski 等人發展成確定性的光學修形技術，1996 年成立的 QED Technologies 把它商品化為數控機台，2001 年該技術獲得美國國防部的製造技術獎。此後磁流變拋光成為非球面、自由曲面與高功率雷射光學的標準修形工具，與離子束修形互補。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何流體配方。
history.textEn: The magnetorheological finishing concept was proposed by William Kordonski and colleagues in Minsk in the late 1980s, developed in the 1990s at the University of Rochester Center for Optics Manufacturing by Jacobs, Golini, Kordonski and others into a deterministic optical figuring technique, commercialised as CNC machines by QED Technologies, founded in 1996, and recognised with a U.S. Department of Defense manufacturing-technology award in 2001. MRF has since become a standard figuring tool for aspheres, freeforms and high-power laser optics, complementary to ion-beam figuring. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not any fluid formulation.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
history.text: 1817 年 Fraunhofer 注意到表面風化的玻璃反射較弱，1886 年 Rayleigh 以漸變折射率解釋；1935 年蔡司的 Alexander Smakula 取得真空蒸鍍增透膜專利，1946 年 Max Auwärter 在列支敦斯登創立 Balzers，把真空鍍膜變成產業。Angus Macleod 於 1969 年出版的《Thin-Film Optical Filters》確立了特徵矩陣與導納圖的設計語言；1980 年代離子輔助與離子束濺鍍把膜層密度推近塊材，1990 年代光纖通訊的密集分波多工濾光片把厚度控制推到 0.01% 等級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1817 Fraunhofer noticed that weathered glass reflects less, and in 1886 Rayleigh explained it with a graded index; in 1935 Alexander Smakula at Zeiss patented vacuum-evaporated antireflection coatings, and in 1946 Max Auwärter founded Balzers in Liechtenstein, turning vacuum coating into an industry. Angus Macleod's Thin-Film Optical Filters of 1969 established the characteristic-matrix and admittance-diagram design language; in the 1980s ion assistance and ion-beam sputtering pushed film density toward bulk, and in the 1990s dense-wavelength-division-multiplexing filters for fibre communication drove thickness control to the 0.01% level. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 增透膜設計與沉積
history.text: 1817 年 Fraunhofer 觀察到表面風化的玻璃反射較弱，1904 年 Harold Dennis Taylor 取得以化學處理鏡片降低反射的專利，1935 年 Alexander Smakula 在蔡司取得真空蒸鍍氟化物增透膜的專利並在二次大戰期間用於軍用光學，1938 年 Katharine Blodgett 以單分子膜展示「不反光玻璃」。1940 年代末的雙層設計與 1950 至 60 年代 Cox 與 Hass 等人的四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜奠定了今天多層增透膜的基礎，1970 年代 Clapham 與 Hutley 提出仿蛾眼的次波長結構，近年的電漿蝕刻奈米結構與最佳化多層設計把平均反射率推到 0.1% 等級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Fraunhofer observed in 1817 that weathered glass reflects less; Harold Dennis Taylor patented a chemical lens treatment to reduce reflection in 1904; Alexander Smakula at Zeiss patented vacuum-evaporated fluoride antireflection coatings in 1935, used on military optics during the Second World War; and Katharine Blodgett demonstrated non-reflecting glass with monomolecular films in 1938. Two-layer designs of the late 1940s and the quarter-half-quarter broadband films of Cox, Hass and others in the 1950s and 1960s laid the foundation of today's multilayer antireflection coatings, Clapham and Hutley proposed moth-eye sub-wavelength structures in 1973, and recent plasma-etched nanostructures and optimised multilayers push average reflectance to the 0.1% level. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高反射雷射鏡片
history.text: 1960 年 Maiman 的紅寶石雷射以鍍銀端面作鏡，數年內介電多層膜取代金屬成為雷射鏡的標準；1980 年代為了環形雷射陀螺儀的 ppm 級損耗，離子束濺鍍被發展成雷射鏡的主流製程，1994 年 Szipőcs 與 Krausz 等人提出的啁啾鏡把色散控制帶入超快雷射。重力波探測器把要求推到極限：LIGO 與 Virgo 的測試質量鏡以 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 多層膜達到次 ppm 吸收，並把鍍膜熱噪聲列為靈敏度極限之一。損傷門檻測試先後由 ISO 11254 與 ISO 21254 標準化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Maiman's 1960 ruby laser used silvered end faces as mirrors, and within a few years dielectric multilayers replaced metal as the standard; in the 1980s ion-beam sputtering became the mainstream laser-mirror process to reach ppm loss for ring-laser gyroscopes, and in 1994 Szipőcs, Krausz and colleagues introduced chirped mirrors that brought dispersion control to ultrafast lasers. Gravitational-wave detectors pushed the requirements to the limit: the LIGO and Virgo test-mass mirrors use Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ multilayers with sub-ppm absorption and treat coating thermal noise as one of the sensitivity limits. Damage-threshold testing was standardised first by ISO 11254 and then by ISO 21254. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 偏振光學元件製作
history.text: 1808 年 Malus 發現反射光的偏振並給出以他為名的定律，1817 年 Fresnel 提出以兩次全反射產生圓偏振的菱體，1828 年 Nicol 以方解石製成第一個實用偏振稜鏡，Glan 與 Thompson 在 1880 年代改良為今天的 Glan 型稜鏡。1929 年 Edwin Land 發明聚合物片偏振片並創立 Polaroid，1946 年 MacNeille 取得薄膜偏振分光器專利；線柵偏振器從 1888 年 Hertz 的無線電實驗、1960 年 Bird 與 Parrish 的紅外線柵，到 2000 年代奈米壓印的可見光鋁線柵，把偏振元件推向大面積量產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Malus discovered polarization by reflection in 1808 and gave the law that bears his name; Fresnel proposed the rhomb that produces circular polarization by two total internal reflections in 1817; Nicol made the first practical calcite polarizing prism in 1828, refined by Glan and Thompson in the 1880s into today's Glan-type prisms. Edwin Land invented the polymer sheet polarizer in 1929 and founded Polaroid, and MacNeille patented the thin-film polarizing beam splitter in 1946; wire-grid polarizers run from Hertz's radio experiments of 1888 through Bird and Parrish's infrared grids of 1960 to nanoimprinted visible aluminium grids of the 2000s, bringing polarization optics to large-area mass production. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 繞射光學元件製作
history.text: 1875 年 Soret 製作了 Fresnel 波帶片，1969 年 IBM 的 Lesem、Hirsch 與 Jordan 提出以 2π 摺疊相位的 kinoform，1971 年 Dammann 發表二元相位分束光柵。1980 年代 MIT 林肯實驗室的 Veldkamp 與 Swanson 提出「二元光學」，以多道光罩與離子蝕刻製作多階繞射元件並建立 sinc² 效率理論，1989 年的技術報告成為此領域的標準參考；1990 年代後，繞射元件進入雷射光束整形、光譜儀與消費相機的混合折射繞射鏡頭，奈米壓印與灰階直寫則把它推向量產與連續輪廓。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Soret made Fresnel zone plates in 1875; Lesem, Hirsch and Jordan at IBM introduced the kinoform with 2π-wrapped phase in 1969; Dammann published binary-phase splitting gratings in 1971. In the 1980s Veldkamp and Swanson at MIT Lincoln Laboratory introduced binary optics, making multilevel diffractive elements with multiple masks and ion etching and establishing the sinc² efficiency theory, and their 1989 technical report became the field's standard reference; from the 1990s diffractive elements entered laser beam shaping, spectrometers and hybrid refractive-diffractive camera lenses, while nanoimprint and grayscale writing carried them to volume production and continuous profiles. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超穎透鏡製程研究
history.text: 2011 年哈佛 Capasso 團隊以電漿子天線陣列提出廣義 Snell 定律，2016 年同團隊以 TiO₂ 奈米柱做出可見光高 NA 超穎透鏡，開啟以半導體製程製作透鏡的研究路線；Metalenz 於 2016 年由該團隊衍生成立，2022 年與 STMicroelectronics 把超穎表面光學元件導入 300 mm 半導體產線的飛時測距模組。2024 年哈佛團隊以 DUV 投影微影與場拼接做出直徑 10 公分、含約 187 億根奈米柱的全玻璃超穎透鏡並拍攝太陽與星雲。本課只重建公開物理與製程邏輯，不含任何專有配方。
history.textEn: In 2011 the Capasso group at Harvard proposed the generalized Snell law with plasmonic antenna arrays, and in 2016 the same group demonstrated a visible high-NA metalens from TiO₂ nanopillars, opening the route of making lenses with semiconductor processes; Metalenz spun out of that group in 2016 and in 2022, with STMicroelectronics, brought metasurface optics into time-of-flight modules on 300 mm semiconductor lines. In 2024 the Harvard team used DUV projection lithography with field stitching to build a 10 cm all-glass metalens of about 18.7 billion nanopillars and imaged the Sun and a nebula. This course reconstructs only public physics and process logic, with no proprietary recipe.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 全像光學元件製作
history.text: 1947 年 Gabor 提出全像術，1962 年 Leith 與 Upatnieks 的離軸全像與 Denisyuk 的反射式全像使高品質記錄成為可能；1969 年貝爾實驗室的 Kogelnik 發表厚全像光柵的耦合波理論，至今仍是體全像元件設計的基本工具。1960 年代末 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）以雷射干涉曝光製作無鬼線的全像光柵，1970 到 80 年代重鉻酸鹽明膠全像元件進入抬頭顯示器，2000 年代起體相位全像光柵成為天文光譜儀（如 ESO 的 MUSE）的主流色散元件，2010 年代自顯影光聚合物薄膜讓擴增實境波導與車用合成器得以量產。
history.textEn: Gabor proposed holography in 1947, and in 1962 the off-axis holography of Leith and Upatnieks and the reflection holograms of Denisyuk made high-quality recording possible; in 1969 Kogelnik at Bell Laboratories published the coupled-wave theory of thick hologram gratings, still the basic design tool for volume elements. In the late 1960s Jobin Yvon (now HORIBA) made ghost-free holographic gratings by laser-interference exposure, dichromated-gelatin elements entered head-up displays in the 1970s and 1980s, volume phase holographic gratings became the standard dispersers of astronomical spectrographs such as ESO's MUSE from the 2000s, and self-developing photopolymer films in the 2010s enabled mass production of augmented-reality waveguides and automotive combiners.

references.scopeEn: Explains that VPH gratings work by index modulation rather than grooves, that working wavelength is set by thickness and modulation amplitude, and compares polarization dependence and angle tuning with surface-relief gratings; a public technology page.

references.scopeEn: Publicly lists each MUSE spectrograph as collimator, volume phase holographic grating and camera, covering 480–930 nm with resolving power about 1770 to 3590; a reference for volume gratings in a real astronomical instrument.

references.title: HORIBA：刻劃式與全像式繞射光柵技術頁
references.titleEn: HORIBA: Ruled and holographic diffraction gratings
references.scope: 說明全像光柵以兩束雷射干涉條紋曝光製作、無週期刻劃誤差故無鬼線、雜散光較低、可達 6000 線/mm 與離子蝕刻層狀槽形；不含製程參數。
references.scopeEn: Explains that holographic gratings are exposed with two-beam laser interference fringes, have no ghosts because there are no periodic ruling errors, show lower stray light, reach 6000 lines/mm and can be ion-etched to laminar profiles; no process parameters.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 液晶空間光調制器
history.text: 1970 年代 Hughes 的液晶光閥首次把液晶用於光學影像調制；1990 年代矽基液晶（LCOS）為投影顯示而發展出高解析 CMOS 背板，2000 年代前後 Hamamatsu、Boulder Nonlinear Systems（今 Meadowlark Optics）與 HOLOEYE 把它改造成純相位調制器，並隨全像光鑷、顯微鏡自適應光學與電信波長選擇開關普及。2010 年代起，介電膜反射層與水冷封裝讓調制器能承受數百瓦雷射，進入雷射加工與平行微影；本課只整理公開的物理與校正方法。
history.textEn: In the 1970s the Hughes liquid-crystal light valve first used liquid crystal for optical image modulation; in the 1990s liquid crystal on silicon (LCOS) developed high-resolution CMOS backplanes for projection displays, and around the 2000s Hamamatsu, Boulder Nonlinear Systems (now Meadowlark Optics) and HOLOEYE turned it into phase-only modulators that spread with holographic optical tweezers, adaptive optics for microscopy and wavelength-selective switches in telecom. From the 2010s dielectric mirror layers and water-cooled packages let modulators withstand several hundred watts of laser power, entering laser processing and parallel lithography; this course covers only public physics and calibration methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 數位微鏡光學引擎
history.text: 1987 年德州儀器的 Larry Hornbeck 發明數位微鏡元件，1996 年 DLP 投影技術商品化，2000 年前後進入數位電影放映；微鏡傾角由早期的 ±10° 演進到 ±12° 與 ±17°，像素間距縮到 5 µm 級。2010 年代起高圖樣率控制器讓 DMD 成為結構光三維量測、光固化 3D 列印、無光罩微影與壓縮感測光譜儀的核心元件，台灣的揚明光學等廠商則專精於 DLP 光學引擎的量產；本課只整理公開的光學設計與量測方法。
history.textEn: Larry Hornbeck at Texas Instruments invented the digital micromirror device in 1987, DLP projection was commercialized in 1996 and entered digital cinema around 2000; mirror tilt evolved from the early ±10° to ±12° and ±17°, and pitches shrank toward the 5 µm class. From the 2010s high-pattern-rate controllers made the DMD the core of structured-light 3D measurement, photopolymer 3D printing, maskless lithography and compressive-sensing spectrometers, while Taiwanese makers such as Young Optics specialized in volume production of DLP optical engines; this course covers only public optical design and measurement methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 相位式計算全像
history.text: 1966 至 1967 年 IBM 的 Lohmann 與 Brown 以繞路相位法用繪圖機與縮小攝影做出第一批計算全像；1972 年劍橋 Cavendish 實驗室的 Gerchberg 與 Saxton 為電子顯微相位還原提出交替投影演算法，1982 年 Fienup 將其推廣為誤差縮減與混合輸入輸出法，1988 年 Wyrowski 與 Bryngdahl 的迭代傅立葉轉換演算法使純相位繞射元件設計成熟。2000 年前後液晶 SLM 使全像光鑷與動態光束整形普及；2019 至 2020 年 Wirtinger 全像與史丹佛的 Neural Holography 引入梯度下降、相機閉環與神經網路，把相位全像推向即時彩色顯示。
history.textEn: In 1966 and 1967 Lohmann and Brown at IBM made the first computer-generated holograms with the detour-phase method using a plotter and photographic reduction; in 1972 Gerchberg and Saxton at the Cavendish Laboratory in Cambridge proposed the alternating-projection algorithm for electron-microscope phase retrieval, Fienup generalized it in 1982 into error-reduction and hybrid input-output methods, and the iterative Fourier-transform algorithm of Wyrowski and Bryngdahl in 1988 matured phase-only diffractive design. Around 2000 liquid-crystal SLMs spread holographic optical tweezers and dynamic beam shaping; in 2019 and 2020 Wirtinger holography and Stanford's Neural Holography brought gradient descent, camera-in-the-loop calibration and neural networks, pushing phase-only holography toward real-time colour displays.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 多視角全像顯示校正
history.text: 1908 年 Gabriel Lippmann 提出整合攝影，以微透鏡陣列記錄並重現多方向光線；20 世紀初 Frederic Ives 的視差屏障與後來的柱狀透鏡把多視角影像做成平面印刷品。1989 年起 MIT 媒體實驗室 Stephen Benton 團隊以聲光調制器打造 Mark I 等全像視訊系統，首次正面遭遇空間頻寬積的瓶頸。2010 年代末起，斜向柱狀透鏡光場顯示器、以高速視覺感測器追蹤雙眼的空間實境顯示器與繞射式多視角背光陸續商品化，逐台的相機式視點映射校正成為量產必要工序。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1908 Gabriel Lippmann proposed integral photography, recording and replaying rays in many directions with a microlens array; early in the twentieth century Frederic Ives's parallax barrier and later lenticular sheets turned multiview images into flat prints. From 1989 Stephen Benton's group at the MIT Media Lab built holographic video systems such as Mark I using acousto-optic modulators and met the space–bandwidth bottleneck head-on. From the late 2010s slanted-lenticular light-field displays, spatial-reality displays that track both eyes with high-speed vision sensors and diffractive multiview backlights reached the market, making unit-by-unit camera-based view-mapping calibration a necessary production step. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雷射散斑抑制
history.text: 雷射在 1960 年問世後不久，研究者就注意到被照亮的粗糙表面布滿閃爍亮點；1962 至 1963 年 Rigden、Gordon 與 Oliver 等人描述了這種顆粒現象，史丹佛大學的 Joseph Goodman 隨後建立散斑的統計理論，並在 2007 年出版《Speckle Phenomena in Optics》專書。2002 年 Silicon Light Machines 的 Jahja Trisnadi 以角度、偏振與波長多樣性相乘的架構分析雷射投影的散斑抑制，並以 Hadamard 相位擴散片在光柵光閥投影機上把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；其後電活性聚合物振動擴散片等小型元件與 RGB 純雷射投影一同普及。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Soon after the laser appeared in 1960, researchers noticed that illuminated rough surfaces were covered with sparkling spots; in 1962 and 1963 Rigden, Gordon and Oliver among others described the granularity, and Joseph Goodman at Stanford went on to build the statistical theory of speckle, later collected in his 2007 book Speckle Phenomena in Optics. In 2002 Jahja Trisnadi of Silicon Light Machines analysed speckle reduction in laser projection as a product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity and used a Hadamard phase diffuser on a grating-light-valve projector to cut contrast from about 70% to 8%; compact devices such as electroactive-polymer oscillating diffusers then spread together with RGB pure-laser projection. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 數位全像顯微鏡
history.text: Gabor 在 1948 年提出全像術，Leith 與 Upatnieks 於 1962 年引入離軸參考光使影像項分離；Goodman 與 Lawrence 在 1967 年示範以電子感測器記錄全像並用電腦重建。1999 年 Cuche、Marquet 與 Depeursinge 在洛桑聯邦理工學院把離軸數位全像與顯微物鏡結合，從單張全像圖同時得到振幅與定量相位，隨後衍生出商用數位全像顯微鏡與活細胞定量相位成像；2010 年代起全像斷層技術進一步把多角度相位資料重建成三維折射率分佈。本課只重建公開的原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Gabor proposed holography in 1948; Leith and Upatnieks introduced the off-axis reference in 1962 to separate the image terms; Goodman and Lawrence in 1967 recorded holograms on an electronic sensor and reconstructed them by computer. In 1999 Cuche, Marquet and Depeursinge at EPFL combined off-axis digital holography with a microscope objective to obtain amplitude and quantitative phase from a single hologram, leading to commercial digital holographic microscopes and live-cell quantitative phase imaging; from the 2010s holotomography reconstructed multi-angle phase data into three-dimensional refractive-index maps. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學同調斷層掃描
history.text: 1991 年 Huang、Swanson、Fujimoto 等人在麻省理工學院與哈佛醫學院合作發表時域 OCT，以低同調干涉對視網膜與動脈進行微米級斷層成像；1996 年第一台商用眼科 OCT 問世。2003 年前後 Leitgeb、de Boer、Choma 等團隊證明頻域偵測的靈敏度優勢，使光譜域與掃頻 OCT 在 2006 年後成為眼科標準檢查，並擴展到心血管內視鏡與工業量測。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有設計。
history.textEn: In 1991 Huang, Swanson, Fujimoto and colleagues at MIT with Harvard Medical School published time-domain OCT, using low-coherence interferometry for micrometre-scale tomography of the retina and arteries; the first commercial ophthalmic OCT appeared in 1996. Around 2003 the groups of Leitgeb, de Boer and Choma demonstrated the sensitivity advantage of Fourier-domain detection, after which spectral-domain and swept-source OCT became a standard ophthalmic examination from about 2006 and spread to intravascular endoscopy and industrial metrology. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic, not any vendor's proprietary design.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 共軛焦顯微鏡
history.text: Marvin Minsky 於 1957 年申請共軛焦掃描顯微鏡專利，以點照明與針孔偵測排除離焦光；1980 年代中期 Amos、White 與 Fordham 等人結合雷射、振鏡與電腦影像，使雷射掃描共軛焦成為生物學標準工具，Zeiss 與 Bio-Rad 隨後推出商用系統。1990 年代轉盤式（Nipkow disk）共軛焦提高了活細胞成像速度，2010 年代的陣列偵測器（如 Airyscan 概念）則在不犧牲訊號下把解析度推過針孔極限。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Marvin Minsky filed the confocal scanning microscope patent in 1957, rejecting out-of-focus light with point illumination and pinhole detection; in the mid-1980s Amos, White, Fordham and others combined lasers, galvanometers and computer imaging to make laser-scanning confocal a standard biological tool, and Zeiss and Bio-Rad soon offered commercial systems. In the 1990s spinning-disk (Nipkow disk) confocals raised live-cell imaging speed, and in the 2010s array detectors such as the Airyscan concept pushed resolution past the pinhole limit without sacrificing signal. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雙光子顯微鏡
history.text: Maria Göppert-Mayer 在 1931 年的博士論文中預測雙光子吸收，但要等到 1990 年 Denk、Strickler 與 Webb 在康乃爾大學把飛秒染料雷射與雷射掃描顯微鏡結合，才首次示範雙光子螢光成像。1990 年代鈦藍寶石雷射的商品化讓技術普及，2000 年代起神經科學以雙光子在活體腦中記錄鈣訊號，Svoboda 等實驗室並公開模組化顯微鏡設計；2010 年代的 1300 與 1700 nm 長波長激發與三光子成像把深度推向 1 mm 以上。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Maria Göppert-Mayer predicted two-photon absorption in her 1931 doctoral thesis, but only in 1990 did Denk, Strickler and Webb at Cornell University combine a femtosecond dye laser with a laser-scanning microscope to demonstrate two-photon fluorescence imaging. Commercial Ti:sapphire lasers in the 1990s spread the technique, from the 2000s neuroscience used two-photon imaging to record calcium signals in living brains, and laboratories such as Svoboda's published modular microscope designs; in the 2010s long-wavelength excitation at 1300 and 1700 nm and three-photon imaging pushed depth beyond 1 mm. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光片顯微鏡
history.text: 1903 年 Siedentopf 與 Zsigmondy 的超顯微鏡以側向照明觀察膠體金粒子，是正交照明的起點；1993 年 Voie 等人以 OPFOS 對透明化耳蝸做光片切片成像。2004 年 EMBL 的 Huisken、Stelzer 等人發表 SPIM，在活體胚胎上展示低光毒性的長時間 3D 成像；2008 年 Keller 等人以數位掃描光片記錄斑馬魚胚胎發育；2011 年 Betzig 團隊引入貝索光束平面照明，2014 年在 Janelia 發表晶格光片顯微鏡；2019 年 mesoSPIM 計畫公開了透明化組織用的大視野軸向掃描光片設計。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1903 Siedentopf and Zsigmondy's ultramicroscope used side illumination to observe colloidal gold particles, the origin of orthogonal illumination; in 1993 Voie and colleagues used OPFOS to image optical sections of a cleared cochlea with a light sheet. In 2004 Huisken, Stelzer and colleagues at EMBL published SPIM, demonstrating long-term low-phototoxicity 3D imaging of live embryos; in 2008 Keller and colleagues recorded zebrafish embryo development with a digitally scanned light sheet; in 2011 Betzig's team introduced Bessel-beam plane illumination and in 2014 published the lattice light-sheet microscope at Janelia; in 2019 the mesoSPIM initiative released a large-field axially scanned light-sheet design for cleared tissue. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超解析螢光顯微鏡
history.text: 1873 年 Ernst Abbe 提出光學顯微鏡的解析度約為半個波長、約 0.2 µm 的極限。1994 年 Stefan Hell 與 Wichmann 提出受激發射損耗（STED）的構想，2000 年前後以實驗證明；同年 Mats Gustafsson 發表結構照明顯微鏡，把寬場解析度提高約兩倍；1989 年 W. E. Moerner 首次偵測單一分子的光吸收，為單分子方法奠基，2006 年 Betzig 與 Hess 的 PALM、莊小威團隊的 STORM 與 Hess 團隊的 FPALM 幾乎同時發表。2014 年 Betzig、Hell 與 Moerner 因超解析螢光顯微術獲諾貝爾化學獎。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1873 Ernst Abbe set the resolution limit of optical microscopes at about half a wavelength, roughly 0.2 µm. In 1994 Stefan Hell and Wichmann proposed stimulated emission depletion (STED), demonstrated experimentally around 2000; in the same year Mats Gustafsson published structured illumination microscopy, roughly doubling widefield resolution. In 1989 W. E. Moerner first detected the optical absorption of a single molecule, laying the groundwork for single-molecule methods, and in 2006 PALM by Betzig and Hess, STORM by Xiaowei Zhuang's group and FPALM by Hess's group appeared almost simultaneously. In 2014 Betzig, Hell and Moerner received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for super-resolved fluorescence microscopy. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拉曼顯微光譜儀
history.text: 1928 年 C. V. Raman 與 K. S. Krishnan 在加爾各答以濾過的太陽光與汞燈觀察到液體的非彈性散射，同年 Landsberg 與 Mandelstam 在莫斯科於石英中獨立發現同一效應，Raman 於 1930 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1960 年代雷射讓拉曼光譜成為實用技術，1975 年 Delhaye 與 Dhamelincourt 在法國里爾發表雷射拉曼微探針，由 Jobin Yvon（今 HORIBA）商品化；1990 年代 CCD、全像陷波濾光片與共軛焦設計讓拉曼顯微光譜儀成為材料、半導體應力與製藥分析的日常工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1928 C. V. Raman and K. S. Krishnan in Calcutta observed inelastic scattering from liquids using filtered sunlight and mercury lamps, while Landsberg and Mandelstam in Moscow independently found the same effect in quartz that year, and Raman received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics. Lasers made Raman spectroscopy practical in the 1960s, and in 1975 Delhaye and Dhamelincourt in Lille published the laser Raman microprobe that Jobin Yvon, now HORIBA, commercialised; in the 1990s CCDs, holographic notch filters and confocal designs made the Raman microspectrometer a routine tool for materials, semiconductor stress and pharmaceutical analysis. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 傅立葉轉換紅外光譜儀
history.text: 麥克森在 1880 年代建立干涉儀並用它分析譜線的精細結構，但把干涉圖轉成光譜需要大量計算；直到 1949 年費爾蓋特指出多工優勢、1954 年雅基諾指出通量優勢，以及 1965 年 Cooley–Tukey 快速傅立葉轉換問世，FTIR 才在 1960 年代末由 Digilab 等公司商品化。1970–80 年代以氦氖雷射取樣與迷你電腦為基礎的桌上型儀器讓 FTIR 取代色散式紅外光譜儀，成為今日化學、材料與製藥實驗室的標準設備；本課只重建公開的儀器原理與驗證方法。
history.textEn: Michelson built his interferometer in the 1880s and used it to analyse spectral fine structure, but turning interferograms into spectra demanded heavy computation; only after Fellgett identified the multiplex advantage in 1949, Jacquinot the throughput advantage in 1954, and the Cooley–Tukey fast Fourier transform appeared in 1965 did companies such as Digilab commercialise FTIR in the late 1960s. Bench-top instruments built on HeNe-laser sampling and minicomputers in the 1970s and 1980s displaced dispersive infrared spectrometers, making FTIR standard equipment in chemistry, materials and pharmaceutical laboratories; this course reconstructs only public instrument principles and verification methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
history.text: 德魯德在 1887–1890 年間推導出反射偏振理論並以此量測金屬上的薄膜，是橢偏術的起點；1945 年 Rothen 建造了第一台以此命名的「橢偏儀」。1975 年 Aspnes 與 Studna 發表自動化旋轉檢偏鏡橢偏儀，使 Ψ、Δ 能以電子方式快速取得；1980–90 年代光譜型與可變角度儀器商品化（J.A. Woollam 於 1987 年成立、法國 SOPRA、美國 Rudolph 等），橢偏儀隨後成為半導體廠閘極氧化層與多層膜的例行量測工具。本課重建的是公開的物理與建置邏輯，不涉及任何廠商的專有演算法。
history.textEn: Drude derived the theory of reflected polarization between 1887 and 1890 and used it to measure thin films on metals, the origin of ellipsometry; in 1945 Rothen built the first instrument to carry the name ellipsometer. In 1975 Aspnes and Studna published the automated rotating-analyzer ellipsometer, making Ψ and Δ available electronically and quickly; spectroscopic and variable-angle instruments were commercialised in the 1980s and 1990s (J.A. Woollam founded in 1987, SOPRA in France, Rudolph in the United States), and ellipsometers then became routine tools for gate oxides and multilayer stacks in semiconductor fabs. This course reconstructs public physics and construction logic, not any vendor's proprietary algorithm.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 積分球輻射量測
history.text: 1892 年 Sumpner 提出以漫反射球腔量測總光通量的原理，1900 年 Ulbricht 建造實用的「烏布利希球」並用於燈具光通量量測，積分球因此在歐洲常以他命名。二十世紀中葉國際照明委員會（CIE）將替代法與自吸收修正寫入光通量量測技術報告，1979 年成立的 Labsphere 在 1980 年代推出燒結 PTFE 漫反射材料，使可見到近紅外的壁面反射率達到 0.99；近年 LED 照明普及，CIE S 025 等標準與 NIST 的總光譜輻射通量刻度把積分球量測推向光譜化與更低的不確定度。本課只重建公開原理與量測程序。
history.textEn: In 1892 Sumpner proposed measuring total luminous flux with a diffusely reflecting spherical cavity, and in 1900 Ulbricht built the practical Ulbricht sphere for lamp flux measurement, which is why the device often carries his name in Europe. In the mid-twentieth century the International Commission on Illumination (CIE) codified substitution and self-absorption correction in its luminous-flux technical reports; Labsphere, founded in 1979, introduced sintered-PTFE diffuse material in the 1980s, raising wall reflectance to 0.99 from the visible to the near infrared. With the spread of LED lighting, standards such as CIE S 025 and NIST's total spectral radiant flux scale have pushed sphere measurement toward spectral methods and lower uncertainty; this course reconstructs only public principles and procedures.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統
history.text: 1999–2000 年間，Hänsch 在德國馬克斯普朗克量子光學研究所與 Hall 在美國 JILA 的團隊分別以鈦藍寶石鎖模雷射與微結構光纖實現自參考的光學頻率梳，把過去需要整個房間的諧波頻率鏈縮成一台雷射，兩人因此分享 2005 年諾貝爾物理獎。2001 年 Menlo Systems 作為 MPQ 衍生公司成立，2000 年代中期摻鉺光纖梳使頻率梳成為可全天候運轉的商用儀器；2007 年起微共振腔克爾梳開啟晶片化方向。今日頻率梳是光學原子鐘、精密光譜、天文光譜儀校正與光纖時頻傳遞的核心。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Between 1999 and 2000 the groups of Hänsch at the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics in Germany and Hall at JILA in the United States realised self-referenced optical frequency combs with titanium-sapphire mode-locked lasers and microstructured fibre, shrinking harmonic frequency chains that once filled a room into a single laser, for which the two shared the 2005 Nobel Prize in Physics. Menlo Systems was founded in 2001 as an MPQ spin-off, erbium fibre combs in the mid-2000s turned the comb into a commercial instrument that runs around the clock, and from 2007 microresonator Kerr combs opened the chip-scale direction. Today combs are central to optical atomic clocks, precision spectroscopy, astronomical spectrograph calibration and fibre time-frequency transfer; this course reconstructs only public principles and engineering methods.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統
history.titleEn: Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems
history.text: 2000 年前後自參考頻率梳的出現使光頻可以被直接計數，光鐘才從構想變成可行；2001–2003 年香取秀俊提出以魔術波長光晶格囚禁中性原子的構想，2005–2006 年東京大學、JILA 與 LNE-SYRTE 相繼實現鍶晶格鐘。2010 年代 JILA 的鍶鐘與 NIST 的鐿鐘把系統不確定度推進到 10⁻¹⁸ 等級，PTB 在 2017 年展示可運輸的鍶鐘；國際計量界已將光鐘的頻率比值納入 SI 秒重新定義的路線圖，目標在 2030 年前後。本課重建的是公開文獻中的真空、雷射與評估方法，不涉及任何實驗室的專有設計。
history.textEn: The arrival of self-referenced frequency combs around 2000 made optical frequencies directly countable and turned optical clocks from a concept into a feasible instrument; between 2001 and 2003 Hidetoshi Katori proposed trapping neutral atoms in a magic-wavelength lattice, and strontium lattice clocks were realised at the University of Tokyo, JILA and LNE-SYRTE in 2005 and 2006. During the 2010s JILA's strontium and NIST's ytterbium clocks pushed systematic uncertainty to the 10⁻¹⁸ level, and PTB demonstrated a transportable strontium clock in 2017; the international metrology community has placed optical-clock frequency ratios on the roadmap toward a redefinition of the SI second targeted around 2030. This course reconstructs vacuum, laser and evaluation methods from public literature, not any laboratory's proprietary design.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 原子干涉重力儀
history.text: 1991 年 Kasevich 與朱棣文在史丹佛大學以受激拉曼躍遷實現第一台光脈衝原子干涉儀並量到重力，1999–2001 年 Peters、Chung 與朱棣文把準確度推到約 3 µGal，與落體式重力儀相當。2000 年代起法國 LNE-SYRTE、德國洪堡大學（GAIN）與中國的研究團隊發展可運輸的冷原子重力儀並參與國際絕對重力儀比對；2016–2018 年間源自 SYRTE 的 Muquans（現屬 Exail）推出商用絕對量子重力儀，應用於大地測量、火山與水文監測。本課只重建公開文獻中的原理與工程方法，不涉及任何產品的專有設計。
history.textEn: In 1991 Kasevich and Chu at Stanford University realised the first light-pulse atom interferometer using stimulated Raman transitions and measured gravity with it, and between 1999 and 2001 Peters, Chung and Chu pushed the accuracy to about 3 µGal, on a par with free-fall gravimeters. From the 2000s groups at LNE-SYRTE in France, Humboldt University in Germany (GAIN) and in China developed transportable cold-atom gravimeters and joined international comparisons of absolute gravimeters; between 2016 and 2018 the SYRTE spin-off Muquans (now part of Exail) introduced a commercial absolute quantum gravimeter used in geodesy, volcano and hydrology monitoring. This course reconstructs only principles and engineering methods from public literature, not any product's proprietary design.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光纖陀螺儀
history.text: 1913 年薩格納克以旋轉的環形干涉儀證明旋轉會產生條紋位移；1976 年 Vali 與 Shorthill 在猶他大學用光纖線圈首次展示光纖陀螺。1980 年 Ulrich 提出最小互易架構、Shupe 分析出熱瞬態誤差，奠定了實用設計的兩大基礎；1980–90 年代 Lefèvre 等人在法國（Thomson-CSF、Photonetics，後成為 iXsea／iXblue，現為 Exail）發展出閉迴路數位相位斜坡與鈮酸鋰積體光學晶片，Honeywell 與 Northrop Grumman 則把光纖陀螺用於航空、船艦與太空慣性量測單元。今日光纖陀螺涵蓋戰術級到戰略級，是無 GNSS 環境下導航的主要慣性感測器之一。本課只重建公開原理與測試方法。
history.textEn: In 1913 Sagnac showed with a rotating ring interferometer that rotation shifts interference fringes; in 1976 Vali and Shorthill at the University of Utah demonstrated the first fiber-optic gyroscope with a fiber coil. In 1980 Ulrich proposed the minimum reciprocal configuration and Shupe analysed the thermal-transient error, the two foundations of practical design; through the 1980s and 1990s Lefèvre and colleagues in France (Thomson-CSF, Photonetics, later iXsea/iXblue and now Exail) developed the closed-loop digital phase ramp and the lithium-niobate integrated-optic chip, while Honeywell and Northrop Grumman applied FOGs to aircraft, ships and spacecraft inertial measurement units. FOGs today span tactical to strategic grade and are among the main inertial sensors for navigation without GNSS; this course reconstructs only public principles and test methods.

history.text: Sagnac 在 1913 年以旋轉的環形干涉儀示範了反向光束的相位差；1963 年 Macek 與 Davis 在 Sperry 以 HeNe 環形雷射首次量到旋轉引起的拍頻，鎖定問題隨即被發現並由機械抖動解決。1980 年代 Honeywell 的環形雷射陀螺儀慣性導航系統進入波音民航機，使無運動件的捷聯式導航成為主流；2000 年代起德國 Wettzell 大地測量站的 4 m×4 m 大型環形雷射 G 以連續監測地球自轉的方式把同一物理推到 10⁻⁹ 的相對精度。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Sagnac demonstrated the phase difference between counter-propagating beams in a rotating ring interferometer in 1913; in 1963 Macek and Davis at Sperry first measured a rotation-induced beat in a HeNe ring laser, after which lock-in was discovered and solved with mechanical dither. In the 1980s Honeywell ring-laser-gyro inertial navigation entered Boeing airliners and made strapdown navigation without moving parts the mainstream; from the 2000s the 4 m × 4 m large ring laser G at the Wettzell geodetic observatory in Germany pushed the same physics to 10⁻⁹ relative precision by continuously monitoring Earth rotation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雷射干涉位移量測
history.text: Michelson 在 1890 年代以干涉儀用鎘紅線定義公尺，奠定以波長作長度單位的思路；1960 年公尺改以 Kr-86 波長定義，同年 HeNe 雷射問世，1970 年代 Hewlett-Packard 推出以 Zeeman 雙頻 HeNe 為核心的商用外差式干涉儀，使機台校正與晶圓台定位得以追溯到波長。1983 年公尺改由光速定義後，碘穩頻 HeNe 的 632.99 nm 成為 CIPM 建議的實現方式，Edlén 公式及其修正版與 Ciddor 公式則提供空氣折射率的公開計算基礎，今日 NIST 仍以線上工具箱公開提供。本課只重建公開原理，不涉及任何廠商的專有訊號處理。
history.textEn: Michelson used an interferometer in the 1890s to express the metre in cadmium red-line wavelengths, establishing the wavelength as a unit of length; in 1960 the metre was redefined by the Kr-86 wavelength, the same year the HeNe laser appeared, and in the 1970s Hewlett-Packard introduced commercial heterodyne interferometers built on Zeeman two-frequency HeNe lasers, making machine calibration and wafer-stage positioning traceable to the wavelength. After the 1983 speed-of-light definition of the metre, the iodine-stabilised HeNe at 632.99 nm became a CIPM-recommended realisation, while the Edlén equation with its revisions and the Ciddor equation gave a public basis for air-index computation, still offered online by NIST today. This course reconstructs public principles only, not any vendor's proprietary signal processing.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
history.text: 1980 年代中期 Davidson、Kino 等人把低相干光源與干涉顯微鏡結合，證明可用包絡位置量高度而不受 λ/2 模糊限制；1990 年代初 Zygo 的 Deck 與 de Groot 以頻域分析把相干掃描干涉術推向商用，Wyko（後併入 Veeco，再成為 Bruker 一部分）則以垂直掃描干涉術進入半導體與資料儲存產業。2010 年代 ISO 25178 系列把面輪廓量測的計量特性與校正程序標準化，其中 25178-604 專門規範相干掃描干涉儀，使不同廠牌儀器的量測可相互比較。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: In the mid-1980s Davidson, Kino and others combined low-coherence sources with interference microscopes, showing that envelope position measures height free of the λ/2 ambiguity; in the early 1990s Deck and de Groot at Zygo brought coherence scanning interferometry to market with frequency-domain analysis, while Wyko (later part of Veeco and then Bruker) entered semiconductor and data-storage industries with vertical scanning interferometry. In the 2010s the ISO 25178 series standardised metrological characteristics and calibration procedures for areal surface texture, with 25178-604 dedicated to coherence scanning interferometers, making measurements from different makers comparable. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 掃描電子顯微鏡
history.text: 1930 年代 Knoll 與 von Ardenne 提出並實作掃描式電子成像，1940 年代 Zworykin 團隊在 RCA 建造早期原型；1950 到 60 年代劍橋大學 Oatley 實驗室解決了偵測與訊噪問題，Everhart 與 Thornley 在 1960 年發表的閃爍體加光電倍增管偵測器至今仍是標準配備，1965 年 Cambridge Instruments 推出第一台商用 SEM。1980 年代起場發射源與浸沒式物鏡把解析度推到奈米以下，低電壓成像與能譜分析使 SEM 成為半導體與材料產業的基礎工具。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Knoll and von Ardenne proposed and demonstrated scanned electron imaging in the 1930s and Zworykin's group at RCA built early prototypes in the 1940s; in the 1950s and 60s Oatley's laboratory at Cambridge solved detection and signal-to-noise problems, the scintillator-photomultiplier detector published by Everhart and Thornley in 1960 remains standard equipment, and Cambridge Instruments shipped the first commercial SEM in 1965. From the 1980s field-emission sources and immersion objectives pushed resolution below a nanometre, and low-voltage imaging with spectroscopy made the SEM a foundation tool of the semiconductor and materials industries. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 穿透電子顯微鏡
history.text: 1931 年 Ruska 與 Knoll 在柏林建造第一台電子顯微鏡，1933 年超越光學顯微鏡的解析度；Scherzer 在 1936 年證明圓對稱靜電磁透鏡的球面像差不可能為負，使像差成為此後六十年的極限。1990 年代 Rose 提出六極校正器方案，Haider、Rose 與 Urban 在 1998 年於 200 kV 儀器上實證 Cs 校正，隨後 CEOS 與各大廠把校正器商品化，300 kV 儀器的資訊極限進入 0.05 到 0.08 nm；單色器、直接電子偵測器與 ppm 級電源使穩定度工程成為今日高解析電子顯微鏡的核心。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Ruska and Knoll built the first electron microscope in Berlin in 1931 and surpassed light-microscope resolution in 1933; Scherzer proved in 1936 that rotationally symmetric electrostatic and magnetic lenses cannot have negative spherical aberration, making aberration the limit for the next sixty years. In the 1990s Rose proposed the hexapole corrector, Haider, Rose and Urban demonstrated Cs correction on a 200 kV instrument in 1998, CEOS and the major makers then commercialised correctors, and the information limit of 300 kV instruments reached 0.05 to 0.08 nm; monochromators, direct electron detectors and ppm-level supplies made stability engineering the core of today's high-resolution electron microscopy. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低溫電子顯微鏡
history.text: 1980 年代 Dubochet 在 EMBL 證明水可被急凍成玻璃態冰並在電子顯微鏡中觀察，解決了含水樣品的真空問題；Frank 發展單顆粒平均與三維重建方法，Henderson 以細菌視紫質示範接近原子解析度的電子晶體學，三人於 2017 年獲諾貝爾化學獎。2013 年直接電子偵測器與電影式漂移修正帶來「解析度革命」，單顆粒重建普遍進入 3 Å 以下；國家級設施如英國 Diamond 光源的 eBIC 以 300 kV 自動化顯微鏡提供全天候的使用者服務，2020 年去鐵蛋白達到 1.2 Å。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: In the 1980s Dubochet at EMBL showed that water can be flash-frozen into vitreous ice and observed in the electron microscope, solving the vacuum problem for hydrated specimens; Frank developed single-particle averaging and three-dimensional reconstruction, Henderson demonstrated near-atomic electron crystallography with bacteriorhodopsin, and the three shared the 2017 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. In 2013 direct electron detectors and movie-based motion correction brought the resolution revolution, with single-particle reconstructions routinely below 3 Å; national facilities such as eBIC at the UK's Diamond Light Source provide round-the-clock user service on automated 300 kV microscopes, and apoferritin reached 1.2 Å in 2020. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 聚焦離子束分析系統
history.text: 1970 年代液態金屬離子源在太空推進與表面分析研究中發展成熟，1979 年美國 Hughes Research Laboratories 的 Seliger 等人以鎵源展示次微米光點的掃描離子探針。1980 年代 FIB 用於光罩修補與積體電路修改，1990 年代 FEI 等公司把 FIB 與 SEM 結合成雙束系統，使 TEM 試片製備與失效分析成為半導體與材料實驗室的例行工作；2010 年代氙電漿 FIB 把大體積切削速度提高一個數量級以上，支援封裝與電池等大尺度截面。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Liquid-metal ion sources matured in the 1970s through space-propulsion and surface-analysis research, and in 1979 Seliger and colleagues at Hughes Research Laboratories demonstrated a scanning ion probe with a submicrometre spot from a gallium source. In the 1980s FIBs were used for mask repair and integrated-circuit modification, and in the 1990s FEI and others combined FIB and SEM into dual-beam systems that made TEM specimen preparation and failure analysis routine in semiconductor and materials laboratories; in the 2010s xenon plasma FIBs raised bulk removal rates by more than an order of magnitude for large cross-sections of packages and batteries. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡
history.text: 1981 年 Gerd Binnig 與 Heinrich Rohrer 在 IBM 蘇黎世研究實驗室建成第一台掃描穿隧顯微鏡，1983 年拍到 Si(111)-7×7 重構的真實空間影像，兩人因此獲得 1986 年諾貝爾物理獎；1990 年 IBM 的 Don Eigler 用低溫 STM 搬動單一 Xe 原子，證明探針也能操控原子。1990 年代起超高真空低溫 STM 商品化，液氦槽式系統成為表面物理與穿隧能譜的標準平台。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1981 Gerd Binnig and Heinrich Rohrer built the first scanning tunneling microscope at IBM Research in Zurich, imaged the Si(111)-7×7 reconstruction in real space in 1983 and shared the 1986 Nobel Prize in Physics; in 1990 Don Eigler at IBM used a low-temperature STM to position single Xe atoms, showing that the tip can also manipulate matter. Ultrahigh-vacuum low-temperature STMs became commercial products from the 1990s, and helium-bath systems are now the standard platform for surface physics and tunneling spectroscopy. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 原子力顯微鏡
history.text: 1986 年 Gerd Binnig、Calvin Quate 與 Christoph Gerber 發表第一台原子力顯微鏡，用 STM 探針讀取金箔懸臂的偏折；1988 年起光槓桿偵測取代穿隧偵測，1989 年 Digital Instruments 推出商用 AFM，1993 年輕敲模式讓軟材料與生物樣品成像成為常規，1995 年 Giessibl 以頻率調變在真空中達到 Si(111)-7×7 的原子解析度。今日 AFM 已是半導體線上量測、材料力學與生物物理的標準工具。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1986 Gerd Binnig, Calvin Quate and Christoph Gerber published the first atomic force microscope, reading the deflection of a gold-foil lever with an STM tip; optical-lever detection replaced tunneling detection from 1988, Digital Instruments shipped a commercial AFM in 1989, tapping mode made soft materials and biological samples routine from 1993, and in 1995 Giessibl reached atomic resolution on Si(111)-7×7 in vacuum with frequency modulation. The AFM is now a standard tool for in-line semiconductor metrology, materials mechanics and biophysics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: X 光光電子能譜儀
history.text: 1950 到 1960 年代 Kai Siegbahn 在烏普薩拉大學建立高解析電子能譜儀並證明內層結合能的化學位移，把技術命名為 ESCA，1981 年獲諾貝爾物理獎；1969 年起商用儀器問世，1970 年代引入石英單色器與半球分析器，1990 年代後影像 XPS、電荷中和與氣體團簇離子源成為標準配備。NIST 的 XPS 與非彈性平均自由徑資料庫以及 ISO 15472 校正標準，使不同儀器的結合能與定量可以互相比較。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In the 1950s and 1960s Kai Siegbahn at Uppsala University built high-resolution electron spectrometers, demonstrated chemical shifts of core-level binding energies and named the technique ESCA, earning the 1981 Nobel Prize in Physics; commercial instruments appeared from 1969, quartz monochromators and hemispherical analysers arrived in the 1970s, and imaging XPS, charge neutralisation and gas-cluster ion sources became standard after the 1990s. The NIST XPS and inelastic-mean-free-path databases and the ISO 15472 calibration standard make binding energies and quantification comparable between instruments. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 次級離子質譜儀
history.text: 1949 年 Herzog 與 Viehböck 在維也納首次以質譜分析濺射出的二次離子；1960 年代 Castaing 與 Slodzian 在奧賽建立離子顯微鏡，1968 年由 CAMECA 商品化為 IMS 300，Liebl 則發展出離子微探針；1969 年 Benninghoven 在明斯特提出靜態 SIMS，1980 年代結合飛行時間分析器，1989 年 ION-TOF 成立。1990 年代後半導體摻雜剖析成為動態 SIMS 的主要應用，CAMECA 的 NanoSIMS 把橫向解析度推進到 50 nm，團簇離子源則打開有機與生物樣品的分析。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1949 Herzog and Viehböck in Vienna first analysed sputtered secondary ions by mass spectrometry; in the 1960s Castaing and Slodzian at Orsay built the ion microscope, commercialised by CAMECA as the IMS 300 in 1968, while Liebl developed the ion microprobe; in 1969 Benninghoven at Münster introduced static SIMS, combined it with time-of-flight analysers in the 1980s, and ION-TOF was founded in 1989. From the 1990s semiconductor dopant profiling became the main application of dynamic SIMS, the CAMECA NanoSIMS pushed lateral resolution to 50 nm, and cluster ion sources opened organic and biological analysis. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 飛行時間質譜儀
history.text: 1946 年賓州大學的 William Stephens 提出飛行時間質量分析的構想，1955 年 Bendix 公司的 Wiley 與 McLaren 發表雙段加速的空間聚焦與時間延遲聚焦，奠定商用儀器的基礎。1973 年 Mamyrin 在列寧格勒提出反射器，大幅提升解析力；1980 年代後期 Karas 與 Hillenkamp 以及島津製作所的田中耕一發展出基質輔助雷射脫附游離（MALDI），田中與電灑游離的 John Fenn 共同獲得 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎；正交加速讓連續的電灑離子源也能接上飛行時間分析器，今日的四極—飛行時間與多次反射式儀器已是蛋白質體與代謝體研究的主力。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1946 William Stephens of the University of Pennsylvania proposed time-of-flight mass analysis, and in 1955 Wiley and McLaren of the Bendix Corporation published two-stage space focusing and time-lag focusing, the basis of commercial instruments. In 1973 Mamyrin in Leningrad proposed the reflectron, greatly raising resolving power; in the late 1980s Karas and Hillenkamp, and Koichi Tanaka at Shimadzu, developed matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionisation (MALDI), and Tanaka shared the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with John Fenn of electrospray ionisation; orthogonal acceleration let continuous electrospray sources feed time-of-flight analysers, and today quadrupole–time-of-flight and multi-reflecting instruments are workhorses of proteomics and metabolomics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 核磁共振光譜儀
history.text: 1938 年 Rabi 以分子束觀測到核磁共振，1945–46 年 Felix Bloch（史丹佛）與 Edward Purcell（哈佛）分別在凝態物質中偵測到 NMR，兩人共獲 1952 年諾貝爾物理獎；1950 年前後發現化學位移與 J 耦合，使 NMR 成為化學結構工具。1966 年 Richard Ernst 與 Weston Anderson 在 Varian 發展脈衝傅立葉轉換 NMR，Ernst 獲 1991 年諾貝爾化學獎；超導磁體從 1960 年代起不斷提高場強，Kurt Wüthrich 以 NMR 解析蛋白質結構獲 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎，2020 年起含高溫超導內插線圈的 1.2 GHz（28.2 T）磁體投入使用。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1938 Rabi observed nuclear magnetic resonance in molecular beams, and in 1945–46 Felix Bloch at Stanford and Edward Purcell at Harvard independently detected NMR in condensed matter, sharing the 1952 Nobel Prize in Physics; the discovery of chemical shift and J coupling around 1950 made NMR a tool for chemical structure. In 1966 Richard Ernst and Weston Anderson at Varian developed pulsed Fourier-transform NMR, earning Ernst the 1991 Nobel Prize in Chemistry; superconducting magnets have raised field strength since the 1960s, Kurt Wüthrich received the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structures by NMR, and from 2020 magnets of 1.2 GHz (28.2 T) with high-temperature-superconductor inserts entered service. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超導磁體低溫系統
history.text: 1908 年 Kamerlingh Onnes 在萊頓液化氦，1911 年發現汞的超導；1961 年貝爾實驗室 Kunzler 等人證明 Nb₃Sn 能在約 8.8 T 下承載高電流密度，NbTi 隨後在 1960 年代成為延展性最好的實用導體。1980 年代 Fermilab Tevatron 成為第一部大型超導同步加速器，全身 MRI 也在同期商品化，使液氦浴磁體走進醫院；1990 年代稀土蓄冷材料讓 GM 與脈衝管冷頭在 4 K 提供瓦級冷量，催生不需補充液氦的傳導冷卻磁體。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1908 Kamerlingh Onnes liquefied helium in Leiden and in 1911 discovered superconductivity in mercury; in 1961 Kunzler and colleagues at Bell Labs showed Nb3Sn carrying high current density near 8.8 T, and NbTi became the ductile practical conductor during the 1960s. In the 1980s the Fermilab Tevatron became the first large superconducting synchrotron and whole-body MRI was commercialized, bringing helium-bath magnets into hospitals; rare-earth regenerator materials in the 1990s let GM and pulse-tube heads deliver watt-level cooling at 4 K, enabling conduction-cooled magnets that need no liquid-helium refills. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 稀釋製冷機
history.text: 1951 年 Heinz London 提出利用 ³He 溶入 ⁴He 的稀釋熱來製冷；1965 年 Leiden 的 Das、de Bruyn Ouboter 與 Taconis 做出第一部可運轉的稀釋製冷機，隨後曼徹斯特與其他實驗室把溫度推進到數十毫克耳文，牛津儀器在 1960 年代末開始商業化生產。2000 年代以脈衝管冷卻器取代液氦的乾式稀釋製冷機問世，2008 年成立於赫爾辛基的 Bluefors 等公司把它變成可無人值守運轉的標準設備，如今是超導量子位元、單光子偵測與低溫物理實驗的基礎平台。本課只討論公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1951 Heinz London proposed cooling by the heat of dilution of ³He into ⁴He; in 1965 Das, de Bruyn Ouboter and Taconis in Leiden built the first working dilution refrigerator, Manchester and other laboratories soon pushed into the tens of millikelvin, and Oxford Instruments began commercial production in the late 1960s. Dry dilution refrigerators that replace liquid helium with pulse-tube cryocoolers appeared in the 2000s, and companies such as Bluefors, founded in Helsinki in 2008, turned them into standard unattended equipment that now underpins superconducting qubits, single-photon detectors and low-temperature physics. This course discusses only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超高真空腔體建置
history.text: 1950 年 Bayard 與 Alpert 把離子真空計的收集極改成細絲，第一次量到 10⁻⁸ Torr 以下的壓力，Alpert 隨後在西屋建立了全金屬、可烘烤的超高真空系統；1958 年 Varian 推出濺射離子泵，1962 年 Wheeler 與 Carlson 在 Varian 發明刀口加銅墊片的 ConFlat 法蘭，奠定今天的標準零件體系。1990 年代末 CERN 的 Benvenuti 等人發展 NEG 薄膜鍍層以供大型加速器使用。如今超高真空腔體是表面科學、分子束磊晶、加速器、光學原子鐘與重力波干涉儀的共同基礎，LIGO 的 4 km 真空管即是世界上最大的超高真空系統之一。
history.textEn: In 1950 Bayard and Alpert replaced the ion-gauge collector with a thin wire and measured below 10⁻⁸ Torr for the first time, and Alpert then built all-metal bakeable ultrahigh-vacuum systems at Westinghouse; Varian introduced the sputter-ion pump in 1958, and in 1962 Wheeler and Carlson at Varian invented the knife-edge, copper-gasket ConFlat flange that defines today's standard component system. In the late 1990s Benvenuti and colleagues at CERN developed NEG thin-film coatings for large accelerators. Ultrahigh-vacuum chambers now underpin surface science, molecular-beam epitaxy, accelerators, optical atomic clocks and gravitational-wave interferometers, LIGO's 4 km beam tubes being among the largest ultrahigh-vacuum systems in the world.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計
history.text: 1906 年 Pirani 提出熱傳導真空計，1913 年 Gaede 做出分子拖曳泵，1923 年 Holweck 加上螺旋槽結構；1937 年 Penning 發明冷陰極游離計，1950 年 Bayard 與 Alpert 的細絲收集極把量測下限推到 10⁻⁸ Torr 以下。1958 年 Becker 在 Arthur Pfeiffer 公司發明軸向葉片的渦輪分子泵，之後陶瓷球混合軸承與主動磁浮軸承相繼普及，混合 Holweck 段讓隔膜泵也能做前級。今天渦輪泵與真空計的組合是分析儀器、半導體製程、加速器與研究腔體的標準抽氣與量測方案。
history.textEn: Pirani proposed the thermal-conductivity gauge in 1906, Gaede built the molecular drag pump in 1913 and Holweck added the spiral-groove geometry in 1923; Penning invented the cold-cathode ionisation gauge in 1937, and in 1950 the thin-wire collector of Bayard and Alpert pushed the measurement floor below 10⁻⁸ Torr. In 1958 Becker at Arthur Pfeiffer invented the axial-bladed turbomolecular pump, ceramic-ball hybrid bearings and active magnetic levitation followed, and hybrid Holweck stages allowed diaphragm pumps to serve as backing. Today the combination of turbopumps and gauges is the standard pumping and measurement solution for analytical instruments, semiconductor processing, accelerators and research chambers.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 無振動精密實驗平台
history.text: 1960 年代雷射與全像術出現後，干涉實驗需要次波長級穩定，早期實驗室使用花崗岩板、沙箱或充氣內胎；隨後鋼製蜂巢桌面與氣墊隔振腳商品化，成為光學實驗室的標準配備。1991 年 Colin Gordon 提出通用振動準則 VC 曲線，讓半導體廠與奈米實驗室能以 rms 速度頻譜規範樓板；1990 年代起主動隔振普及到電子顯微鏡與微影設備，Advanced LIGO 更以多級主動平台搭配四段擺，把地面運動壓低多個數量級。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: After lasers and holography appeared in the 1960s, interference experiments needed sub-wavelength stability, and early laboratories used granite slabs, sand tables or inflated inner tubes; steel honeycomb tops and pneumatic legs were then commercialized and became standard optical-laboratory equipment. In 1991 Colin Gordon proposed the generic vibration criteria, the VC curves, letting semiconductor fabs and nanotechnology laboratories specify floors as rms velocity spectra; from the 1990s active isolation spread to electron microscopes and lithography tools, and Advanced LIGO combines multi-stage active platforms with quadruple pendulums to suppress ground motion by many orders of magnitude. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 同步輻射儲存環
history.text: 1947 年 GE 的 70 MeV 同步加速器首次觀察到同步輻射；1960 至 70 年代同步光先寄生於高能物理環，1968 年 Tantalus 成為第一座專用儲存環。1990 年代 ESRF、APS、SPring-8 與台灣 TLS 等第三代光源以插件磁鐵為主角；2016 年 MAX IV 3 GeV 環首次以多彎消色散晶格把發射度降到數百 pm，ESRF-EBS 於 2020 年把混合多彎晶格帶進 6 GeV 高能環。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1947 synchrotron radiation was first observed at a 70 MeV General Electric synchrotron; in the 1960s and 1970s it was used parasitically on high-energy-physics rings, and Tantalus became the first dedicated storage ring in 1968. Third-generation sources of the 1990s, including ESRF, APS, SPring-8 and Taiwan's TLS, made insertion devices the main sources. In 2016 the 3 GeV MAX IV ring was the first to use a multi-bend achromat to reach emittances of a few hundred picometres, and ESRF-EBS brought a hybrid multi-bend lattice to a 6 GeV ring in 2020. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 自由電子雷射加速器
history.text: 1971 年 John Madey 在史丹佛提出自由電子雷射，1977 年其團隊以超導直線加速器在 3.4 µm 做出第一台 FEL 振盪器；1980 年代 Kondratenko 與 Saldin、Bonifacio、Pellegrini 與 Narducci 建立自發放大自發輻射（SASE）理論，使不需反射鏡的 X 光 FEL 成為可能。2000 年 DESY 的 TESLA 測試設施在 109 nm 觀察到 SASE 增益，2009 年 SLAC 的 LCLS 成為第一台硬 X 光 FEL，2011 年 SACLA 以 C 波段加速與真空內波盪器縮短設施長度，2017 年 European XFEL 以超導直線加速器啟用。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1971 John Madey at Stanford proposed the free-electron laser, and in 1977 his group operated the first FEL oscillator at 3.4 µm using a superconducting linac; in the 1980s Kondratenko and Saldin, and Bonifacio, Pellegrini and Narducci, developed the theory of self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE), making mirrorless X-ray FELs possible. In 2000 the TESLA Test Facility at DESY observed SASE gain at 109 nm, in 2009 SLAC's LCLS became the first hard X-ray FEL, in 2011 SACLA shortened the facility with C-band acceleration and in-vacuum undulators, and in 2017 European XFEL opened with a superconducting linac. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 粒子加速器射頻腔
history.text: 1937 年 Varian 兄弟與 Hansen 在史丹佛發明速調管，提供了驅動微波共振腔的高功率源；1940 年代後期 Alvarez 在柏克萊建成漂移管直線加速器，W. Hansen 團隊則發展出行波電子直線加速器，最終促成 1966 年以 S 頻段速調管驅動的 SLAC 兩英里直線加速器。1990 年代 KEK 為 B 工廠的安培級束流研發 ARES 常溫腔，以加速腔—耦合腔—儲能腔三腔系統抑制束流負載造成的耦合束團不穩定，至今仍用於 SuperKEKB。
history.textEn: In 1937 the Varian brothers and Hansen at Stanford invented the klystron, supplying the high-power source that microwave resonators needed; in the late 1940s Alvarez built the drift-tube linac at Berkeley while Hansen's group developed the travelling-wave electron linac, leading to the two-mile SLAC linac driven by S-band klystrons in 1966. In the 1990s KEK developed the normal-conducting ARES cavity for ampere-class B-factory beams, using an accelerating, coupling and storage three-cavity system to suppress the coupled-bunch instability caused by beam loading, and it remains in use at SuperKEKB.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超導加速腔製作
history.text: 超導射頻加速腔在 1960 年代由史丹佛等實驗室首次展示；傑佛遜實驗室 CEBAF 於 1990 年代以三百多支 1.5 GHz 鈮腔建成第一座大型超導直線加速器。以 DESY 為核心的 TESLA 合作在 1990 年代確立 1.3 GHz 九腔設計與電解拋光、烘烤等處理流程，歐洲 XFEL 在 2010 年代由工業界量產約 800 支腔；費米實驗室 2013 年公開的氮摻雜使 Q₀ 提升兩到三倍，被 LCLS-II 採用。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Superconducting RF cavities were first demonstrated in the 1960s at Stanford and elsewhere; Jefferson Lab's CEBAF became the first large SRF linac in the 1990s with more than three hundred 1.5 GHz niobium cavities. The DESY-centred TESLA collaboration fixed the 1.3 GHz nine-cell design and the electropolishing and baking sequence in the 1990s, and industry produced about 800 cavities for the European XFEL in the 2010s; nitrogen doping published by Fermilab in 2013 raised Q₀ two- to threefold and was adopted for LCLS-II. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 加速器束流位置監測
history.text: 束流位置監測隨 1950 到 1960 年代的同步加速器出現，早期用類比的差和比與對數比電路處理鈕扣或條帶電極訊號。1990 年代第三代光源要求次微米軌道穩定，推動了束流基準對準與全環快速軌道回授；2000 年代起以 FPGA 為核心的數位 BPM 處理器（如 Libera 系列）成為光源標準配備，自由電子雷射則發展出解析度達數十奈米的腔式 BPM。台灣光子源在 2010 年代建置時即採用數位 BPM 與快速軌道回授。
history.textEn: Beam-position monitors appeared with the synchrotrons of the 1950s and 1960s, first processing button or stripline signals with analogue difference-over-sum and log-ratio circuits. Third-generation light sources of the 1990s demanded sub-micrometre orbit stability, driving beam-based alignment and ring-wide fast orbit feedback; from the 2000s FPGA-based digital BPM processors such as the Libera family became standard at light sources, while free-electron lasers developed cavity BPMs with tens-of-nanometre resolution. The Taiwan Photon Source adopted digital BPMs and fast orbit feedback when it was built in the 2010s.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 同步輻射單色器
history.text: 雙晶 X 光光譜儀在 1930 年代由 Compton 與 Allison 等人建立，DuMond 以圖解法描述兩晶體的角度與波長匹配。1970 到 1980 年代同步輻射光源普及後，雙晶單色器成為 XAFS 與繞射光束線的標準元件；第三代光源的插件磁鐵熱負載促使 1980 年代後期提出並在 1990 年代於 ESRF、APS 等實現液氮冷卻矽晶體。今日 Diamond、ESRF-EBS 與台灣光子源等設施的單色器已達次微弧度級穩定度，並以自動化能量校正與峰值鎖定支援使用者。
history.textEn: Double-crystal X-ray spectrometers were established in the 1930s by Compton, Allison and others, with DuMond's diagram describing the angle–wavelength matching of two crystals. After synchrotron sources spread in the 1970s and 1980s the double-crystal monochromator became standard on XAFS and diffraction beamlines; insertion-device heat loads at third-generation sources led to liquid-nitrogen-cooled silicon, proposed in the late 1980s and realised at ESRF, APS and others in the 1990s. Today monochromators at Diamond, ESRF-EBS and the Taiwan Photon Source reach sub-microradian stability and support users with automated energy calibration and peak locking.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高亮度 X 光束線
history.text: 1948 年 Kirkpatrick 與 Baez 提出以兩面正交掠射鏡做 X 光成像，因當時鏡面加工精度不足而長期只是原理；1990 年代以波盪器為主的第三代同步輻射光源（ESRF、APS、SPring-8）讓亮度躍升數個數量級，鏡面斜率誤差與熱負載才成為光束線工程的核心課題，日本與歐美團隊也在 2000 年代把 KB 鏡推進到奈米聚焦。台灣光子源 TPS 為 3 GeV、發射度約 1.6 nm·rad 的儲存環，2014 年底首次出光，其蛋白質結晶學光束線即採用波盪器與 KB 聚焦。
history.textEn: In 1948 Kirkpatrick and Baez proposed X-ray imaging with two orthogonal grazing mirrors, an idea that stayed largely theoretical because mirror fabrication was not precise enough; third-generation undulator sources of the 1990s such as ESRF, APS and SPring-8 raised brilliance by orders of magnitude and made slope error and heat load central to beamline engineering, and Japanese, European and US teams pushed KB mirrors to nanofocusing in the 2000s. The Taiwan Photon Source is a 3 GeV ring with about 1.6 nm·rad emittance that saw first light at the end of 2014, and its protein-crystallography beamlines use undulators with KB focusing.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 中子散射儀
history.text: 1940 年代後期 Shull 在橡樹嶺石墨反應爐以中子繞射解析晶體與磁結構，1950 年代 Brockhouse 在加拿大 Chalk River 發展三軸譜儀量測聲子，兩人因此共同獲得 1994 年諾貝爾物理獎。1967 年法德合作成立勞厄—朗之萬研究所（ILL），其高通量反應爐於 1971 年運轉並率先大規模使用冷源與中子導管；1976 年 Mezei 提出超鏡，大幅提高導管傳輸；橡樹嶺散裂中子源 SNS 於 2006 年產生第一批中子，代表以脈衝散裂源與飛行時間儀器為主的新世代設施。
history.textEn: In the late 1940s Shull used neutron diffraction at the Oak Ridge Graphite Reactor to solve crystal and magnetic structures, and in the 1950s Brockhouse developed the triple-axis spectrometer at Chalk River in Canada to measure phonons, sharing the 1994 Nobel Prize in Physics. France and Germany founded the Institut Laue-Langevin in 1967, whose high-flux reactor started in 1971 and pioneered large-scale use of cold sources and neutron guides; Mezei proposed the supermirror in 1976, greatly raising guide transmission; and the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge produced its first neutrons in 2006, typifying a generation of pulsed spallation facilities built around time-of-flight instruments.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 閃爍體粒子偵測器
history.text: 1948 年 Hofstadter 發現鉈活化碘化鈉 NaI(Tl) 是高光產額的閃爍體，與同時期成熟的光電倍增管結合，使伽瑪能譜學成為常規技術；1970 年代 BGO 以高密度進入正子斷層掃描，1990 年代初 Melcher 等人發展出快速且高密度的 LSO:Ce，奠定現代飛行時間正子斷層掃描的晶體基礎。高能物理方面，CERN 的 CMS 電磁量能器以約 7.6 萬根鎢酸鉛晶體搭配崩潰光二極體與真空光三極管讀出；2000 年代以後矽光電倍增器逐漸在醫學影像與緊湊偵測器中取代部分 PMT。
history.textEn: In 1948 Hofstadter found that thallium-activated sodium iodide NaI(Tl) is a high-yield scintillator, and together with the photomultiplier tubes maturing at the same time it made gamma spectroscopy routine; BGO entered positron emission tomography in the 1970s for its density, and in the early 1990s Melcher and colleagues developed fast, dense LSO:Ce, the crystal basis of modern time-of-flight PET. In high-energy physics the CMS electromagnetic calorimeter at CERN uses about 76 000 lead tungstate crystals read out by avalanche photodiodes and vacuum phototriodes, and from the 2000s silicon photomultipliers began replacing PMTs in medical imaging and compact detectors.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
history.text: 混合式像素偵測器在 1990 年代由 CERN 的 RD19 等研發計畫推動，先在固定靶與 LEP 實驗中運轉，2008 年起 ATLAS 與 CMS 以數千萬像素的混合式系統成為 LHC 的最內層追蹤器，CMS 的像素系統由 PSI 等機構主導建造，並於 2017 年升級為四層的 Phase-1 偵測器。單體式 MAPS 源自可見光 CMOS 影像感測器，2014 年在 RHIC 的 STAR 首次用於對撞機頂點偵測器，2022 年 ALICE ITS2 以約 125 億像素、10 m² 的 ALPIDE 投入運轉。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Hybrid pixel detectors were developed in the 1990s by CERN research programmes such as RD19 and first operated in fixed-target and LEP experiments; from 2008 ATLAS and CMS ran hybrid systems with tens of millions of pixels as the LHC's innermost trackers, the CMS pixel system being built under the lead of PSI and partners and upgraded to the four-layer Phase-1 detector in 2017. Monolithic MAPS grew out of visible-light CMOS image sensors, served first in a collider vertex detector at STAR at RHIC in 2014, and in 2022 ALICE ITS2 began operation with about 12.5 billion ALPIDE pixels over 10 m². This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 時間投影室偵測器
history.text: 時間投影室由 David Nygren 於 1974 年在勞倫斯柏克萊實驗室提出，首先用於 PEP-4 實驗；之後 ALEPH、STAR、ALICE 相繼採用。ALICE TPC 於 2008 年以多絲正比室讀出完工，2019–2021 年升級為四層 GEM 讀出，以支援 Run 3 的連續讀出與 50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞率。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何實驗的內部程序。
history.textEn: The time-projection chamber was proposed by David Nygren at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory in 1974 and first used in the PEP-4 experiment; ALEPH, STAR and ALICE followed. The ALICE TPC was completed in 2008 with multiwire readout and upgraded in 2019–2021 to four-GEM readout for continuous operation at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb rate of Run 3. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only, not any experiment's internal procedures.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低雜訊偵測器讀出
history.text: 電荷靈敏前置放大器與低雜訊讀出的理論由 1960 年代的核子電子學奠定：Radeka 在布魯克海文國家實驗室建立等效雜訊電荷與最佳濾波的分析框架，Goulding 與 Landis 在柏克萊發展脈衝整形與堆積拒絕；1980 年代起矽微條偵測器推動 CMOS 前端 ASIC（如 CERN 的 Amplex 與 Viking 系列），今日 LHC 實驗的數億通道與 HPGe 的 keV 級解析度都建立在同一套 ENC 工程上。本課只重建公開教科書層級的原理與數值方法。
history.textEn: The theory of charge-sensitive preamplifiers and low-noise readout was laid down by nuclear electronics in the 1960s: Radeka at Brookhaven National Laboratory established the equivalent-noise-charge and optimum-filter framework, while Goulding and Landis at Berkeley developed pulse shaping and pile-up rejection; from the 1980s silicon strip detectors drove CMOS front-end ASICs such as CERN's Amplex and Viking families, and today both the hundreds of millions of LHC channels and keV-class HPGe resolution rest on the same ENC engineering. This course reconstructs public textbook-level principles and numerical methods only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文自適應光學
history.text: Horace Babcock 於 1953 年提出以可變形鏡即時補償大氣擾動的構想；1970–80 年代的軍方研究發展出 Shack–Hartmann 感測與變形鏡技術，1991 年解密後進入天文。ESO 在 1989 年於 3.6 m 望遠鏡以 COME-ON 系統首次取得天文 AO 影像，之後 Keck、VLT NACO 相繼投入；2016–2017 年 VLT 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器變形副鏡與四雷射導星啟用，ELT 的 2.4 m M4 則把致動器數推到 5000 以上。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Horace Babcock proposed in 1953 that a deformable mirror could compensate atmospheric distortion in real time; military research in the 1970s and 1980s developed Shack–Hartmann sensing and deformable-mirror technology, released to astronomy after declassification in 1991. ESO obtained the first astronomical AO images with the COME-ON system on its 3.6 m telescope in 1989, followed by Keck and VLT NACO; in 2016–2017 the VLT Adaptive Optics Facility entered service with a 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, and the 2.4 m M4 of the ELT pushes the actuator count beyond 5000. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
history.titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
history.text: 主動光學由 ESO 的 Raymond Wilson 在 1970 至 1980 年代系統化提出，1989 年拉西亞的 3.58 m 新技術望遠鏡（NTT）成為第一座以主動光學運轉的大型望遠鏡，證明薄而軟的主鏡可以由電腦控制的支撐力保持面形。1998 年起 VLT 的四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡沿用此概念，Gemini 與 Subaru 的 8 m 級彎月鏡也各自採用主動支撐，使 8 m 級單片主鏡成為可行。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Active optics was systematised by Raymond Wilson at ESO during the 1970s and 1980s, and in 1989 the 3.58 m New Technology Telescope (NTT) at La Silla became the first large telescope operated with active optics, proving that a thin, flexible primary can hold its figure through computer-controlled support forces. From 1998 the four 8.2 m VLT Unit Telescopes adopted the concept, and the 8 m class menisci of Gemini and Subaru also use active support, making monolithic 8 m primaries feasible. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 分段鏡共相控制
history.text: Jerry Nelson 在 1970 年代末提出以薄六角段鏡拼成大口徑主鏡、並以邊緣感測器與致動器主動維持形狀的概念；1990 年 Keck I 以部分段鏡取得初光，1993 年以完整的 36 片主鏡開始科學觀測，1996 年 Keck II 完成。Gary Chanan 等人隨後發展寬頻與窄頻共相演算法，把段鏡共相到數十奈米。同一套思路延伸到 GTC、TMT 與 ESO 的 39 m ELT，ELT 的 798 片段鏡把感測器與致動器數量提高到數千。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In the late 1970s Jerry Nelson proposed building a large primary from thin hexagonal segments held in shape by edge sensors and actuators; Keck I saw first light with a partial set of segments in 1990, began science observations with the full 36-segment primary in 1993, and Keck II followed in 1996. Gary Chanan and colleagues then developed broadband and narrowband phasing algorithms that phase the segments to tens of nanometres. The same approach extends to GTC, TMT and ESO's 39 m ELT, whose 798 segments raise sensor and actuator counts into the thousands. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文雷射導引星
history.text: 1982 年 William Happer 提出利用中氣層鈉原子做人造導引星，1985 年 Foy 與 Labeyrie 在天文文獻中公開發表此概念；1990 年代中期 Lawrence Livermore 國家實驗室在 Lick 天文台 3 m Shane 望遠鏡上首次以鈉雷射導引星明顯改善天文影像。2004 年 Keck II 開始提供鈉雷射導引星自適應光學，ESO 於 2016 年 4 月在 VLT UT4 啟用以拉曼光纖雷射為基礎的四雷射導引星設施 4LGSF，極大望遠鏡則規劃以多道雷射進行斷層自適應光學。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及雷射操作程序。
history.textEn: In 1982 William Happer proposed using mesospheric sodium as an artificial guide star, and in 1985 Foy and Labeyrie published the concept in the astronomical literature; in the mid-1990s Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory first achieved clear image improvement with a sodium laser guide star on the 3 m Shane telescope at Lick Observatory. Keck II began offering sodium laser-guide-star adaptive optics in 2004, ESO commissioned the Raman-fibre-laser-based Four Laser Guide Star Facility on VLT UT4 in April 2016, and extremely large telescopes plan multi-laser tomographic adaptive optics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not laser operating procedures.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文高解析光譜儀
history.text: 1995 年 Michel Mayor 與 Didier Queloz 以 ELODIE 光纖光譜儀的交叉相關技術發現 51 Pegasi b，精度約 10 m/s 等級；2003 年起 ESO 3.6 m 望遠鏡上的 HARPS 以真空溫控容器與同步 ThAr 參考把長期精度推進到約 1 m/s，2010 年代又在其上測試雷射頻率梳。2017 年 ESPRESSO 在 VLT 組合庫德實驗室取得初光，可接收單一或四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的光，以 10 cm/s 為長期目標。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1995 Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz discovered 51 Pegasi b using cross-correlation with the fibre-fed ELODIE spectrograph at roughly 10 m/s precision; from 2003 HARPS on the ESO 3.6 m telescope pushed long-term precision to about 1 m/s with a vacuum, temperature-controlled vessel and simultaneous ThAr reference, and laser frequency combs were tested on it during the 2010s. In 2017 ESPRESSO saw first light in the VLT combined coudé laboratory, accepting light from one or all four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes with a long-term goal of 10 cm/s. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
history.text: 1920 年 Michelson 與 Pease 在威爾遜山以 6 m 干涉儀量出參宿四的角直徑；1974 年 Labeyrie 首次在兩台獨立望遠鏡之間取得星光條紋，證明分離望遠鏡的光程可以被控制。ESO 的 VLTI 於 2001 年取得首批條紋，延遲線隧道、雷射計量與條紋追蹤隨 AMBER、PIONIER 到 2016 年的 GRAVITY 逐步成熟，GRAVITY 在 2018 年以數十微角秒的天體測量追蹤銀河中心恆星 S2 通過近心點；喬治亞州立大學的 CHARA 陣列自 2005 年起以六台 1 m 望遠鏡與 331 m 基線運作，其真空光管與延遲線至今仍是可見光干涉的參考設計。
history.textEn: In 1920 Michelson and Pease measured the angular diameter of Betelgeuse with a 6 m interferometer on Mount Wilson, and in 1974 Labeyrie obtained the first stellar fringes between two independent telescopes, proving that the optical path between separate telescopes could be controlled. ESO's VLTI recorded its first fringes in 2001, and its delay-line tunnel, laser metrology and fringe tracking matured through AMBER and PIONIER to GRAVITY in 2016, which in 2018 tracked the Galactic-Centre star S2 through pericentre with astrometry at the tens-of-microarcsecond level; the CHARA Array of Georgia State University has operated six 1 m telescopes on a 331 m baseline since 2005, and its vacuum pipes and delay lines remain a reference design for visible-light interferometry.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
history.text: 1933 年 Jansky 偵測到銀河的無線電波後，接收機雜訊一路從真空管、1960 年代的 4 K 邁射放大器（Penzias 與 Wilson 以此發現宇宙微波背景）、1970 年代末的 SIS 混頻器理論與實作，走到 1980–90 年代由 NRAO 中央開發實驗室等單位推動的 GaAs／InP HEMT 低溫放大器。ALMA 的十個波段前端於 2000–2010 年代由歐洲、北美與東亞的多個實驗室分工製作；台灣中央研究院天文所（ASIAA）主導的 Band 1（35–50 GHz）接收機於 2021 年起交付，把低雜訊接收機工程帶進台灣的產學鏈。
history.textEn: After Jansky detected radio emission from the Milky Way in 1933, receiver noise fell from vacuum tubes through the 4 K maser amplifiers of the 1960s (with which Penzias and Wilson found the cosmic microwave background), the SIS mixer theory and devices of the late 1970s, to the cryogenic GaAs/InP HEMT amplifiers advanced by the NRAO Central Development Laboratory and others in the 1980s and 1990s. The ten ALMA band front ends were built by laboratories across Europe, North America and East Asia during the 2000s and 2010s; the Band 1 (35–50 GHz) receivers led by Taiwan's Academia Sinica Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics (ASIAA) began delivery in 2021, bringing low-noise receiver engineering into Taiwan's research and industrial chain.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 電波陣列相關器
history.text: 1946 年 Ryle 與 Vonberg 建成第一台電波干涉儀，Ryle 隨後發展的孔徑合成在 1974 年獲得諾貝爾獎；1970–80 年代 Westerbork 與 VLA 使用數位滯後式相關器，日本野邊山陣列則率先採用 FX 架構。2010 年前後 NRC 加拿大為擴建後的 VLA 建造 WIDAR 相關器，NRAO 為 ALMA 建造可處理 64 台天線、16 GHz 頻寬的基線相關器並於 2012 年在海拔 5000 m 的操作站完成；同一時期柏克萊 CASPER 推出開源 FPGA 板與工具鏈，之後 GPU 的 X 引擎讓 CHIME 等新陣列以商用硬體完成相關運算。
history.textEn: Ryle and Vonberg built the first radio interferometer in 1946, and the aperture synthesis Ryle developed afterwards earned the 1974 Nobel Prize; in the 1970s and 1980s Westerbork and the VLA used digital lag correlators while the Nobeyama array pioneered the FX architecture. Around 2010 NRC Canada built the WIDAR correlator for the expanded VLA, and NRAO built the ALMA baseline correlator handling 64 antennas and 16 GHz of bandwidth, completed in 2012 at the 5000 m operations site; in the same period Berkeley's CASPER released open-source FPGA boards and a toolflow, after which GPU X-engines let new arrays such as CHIME correlate on commercial hardware.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
history.text: 1970 年代 Weiss、Drever 等人提出雷射干涉重力波偵測並建造原型，懸吊從單級鋼絲擺開始；格拉斯哥大學在 1990–2000 年代為 GEO600 發展出焊接熔融石英的單體懸吊，證明熱雜訊可以大幅降低，這項技術由英國團隊（格拉斯哥、伯明翰、盧瑟福實驗室）放大成 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺，於 2015 年首次偵測 GW150914。Virgo 由比薩的 INFN 團隊自 1990 年代發展倒立擺加多級濾波器的超級衰減器，而 KAGRA 則把藍寶石測試質量冷卻到 20 K 以進一步壓低熱雜訊。
history.textEn: In the 1970s Weiss, Drever and others proposed laser-interferometric gravitational-wave detection and built prototypes whose suspensions began as single-stage steel-wire pendulums; the University of Glasgow developed welded fused-silica monolithic suspensions for GEO600 in the 1990s and 2000s, showing that thermal noise could be cut dramatically, and the UK team (Glasgow, Birmingham, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory) scaled the technique into the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum that made the first detection, GW150914, in 2015. Virgo's superattenuator of an inverted pendulum plus a chain of mechanical filters was developed by the INFN team in Pisa from the 1990s, and KAGRA cools sapphire test masses to 20 K to push thermal noise lower still.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低溫紅外偵測器
history.text: HgCdTe 於 1959 年由 Lawson 等人首次合成，1980 年代 Rockwell 與 Santa Barbara Research Center 等公司把它做成銦凸塊混成陣列，1990 年代的 NICMOS（256²）與 HAWAII（1024²）陣列讓哈伯太空望遠鏡與地面望遠鏡進入近紅外巡天時代。2000 年代 Rockwell Scientific（後併入 Teledyne）為 JWST 發展 2048² 的 HAWAII-2RG 與 SIDECAR ASIC，JWST 的 NIRCam、NIRSpec 與 FGS 共使用 15 塊；地面上 VISTA 的 VIRCAM 以 16 塊 2048² 陣列巡天，歐幾里得衛星的 NISP 於 2023 年以 16 塊 H2RG 升空，Roman 太空望遠鏡則採用 18 塊 4096² 的 H4RG。
history.textEn: HgCdTe was first synthesised by Lawson and colleagues in 1959, in the 1980s Rockwell, the Santa Barbara Research Center and others turned it into indium-bump hybrid arrays, and the NICMOS (256²) and HAWAII (1024²) arrays of the 1990s opened the near-infrared survey era for the Hubble Space Telescope and ground-based observatories. In the 2000s Rockwell Scientific, later part of Teledyne, developed the 2048² HAWAII-2RG and the SIDECAR ASIC for JWST, whose NIRCam, NIRSpec and FGS use 15 of them; on the ground VISTA's VIRCAM surveys with 16 2048² arrays, the Euclid NISP instrument launched in 2023 with 16 H2RGs, and the Roman Space Telescope carries 18 4096² H4RGs.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超導奈米線單光子偵測器
history.text: 2001 年 Gol'tsman、Sobolewski 等人以數奈米厚的 NbN 窄條首次展示超導奈米線的單光子偵測；2013 年 NIST 與 JPL 團隊以 WSi 奈米線加光學腔在 1550 nm 達到約 93% 的系統偵測效率。同年 NASA 月球雷射通訊示範的地面站採用 SNSPD 陣列接收機，2023 年 Psyche 任務的深空光通訊實驗也以 SNSPD 陣列在帕洛馬天文台接收雷射訊號。如今 Single Quantum、ID Quantique 等公司提供多通道商用系統。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 2001 Gol'tsman, Sobolewski and colleagues first demonstrated single-photon detection with a superconducting strip of few-nanometre NbN; in 2013 a NIST and JPL team reached about 93% system detection efficiency at 1550 nm with WSi nanowires in an optical cavity. The same year the ground terminal of NASA's Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration used SNSPD array receivers, and in 2023 the Deep Space Optical Communications experiment on the Psyche mission received laser signals at Palomar Observatory with an SNSPD array. Companies such as Single Quantum and ID Quantique now supply multichannel commercial systems. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
history.text: 1969 年貝爾實驗室的 Willard Boyle 與 George Smith 提出電荷耦合元件，2009 年因此獲得諾貝爾物理獎。1970 年代中期 JPL 與亞利桑那大學把 CCD 裝上望遠鏡拍攝行星，其遠高於底片的量子效率與線性很快讓 CCD 取代照相底片；1990 年哈伯太空望遠鏡的廣域行星相機即採用 CCD。近年魯賓天文台的 LSST 相機以 189 片科學 CCD 拼成 32 億像素焦面，每片分 16 個輸出並在約 2 秒內讀完。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1969 Willard Boyle and George Smith at Bell Labs conceived the charge-coupled device, earning the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physics. In the mid-1970s JPL and the University of Arizona put CCDs on telescopes to image planets, and their far higher quantum efficiency and linearity soon displaced photographic plates; the Wide Field/Planetary Camera launched on the Hubble Space Telescope in 1990 used CCDs. More recently the Rubin Observatory LSST Camera tiled 189 science CCDs into a 3.2-gigapixel focal plane, each read through 16 outputs in about 2 seconds. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
history.text: CMOS 主動像素感測器由 NASA 噴射推進實驗室的 Eric Fossum 團隊在 1990 年代初發展，目標是取代功耗高、需要專用製程的 CCD；2009 年 Andor、Fairchild Imaging 與 PCO 共同發表第一代科學級 CMOS，以行級平行 ADC 與相關雙取樣達到約 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊與每秒 100 幀的全幅速度；2016 年前後背照式 sCMOS 把峰值量子效率推到 95%，2021 年量子型 CMOS（qCMOS）更把讀出雜訊降到 0.3 e⁻ 以下，使單一曝光能分辨光子數。本課只整理公開的物理與量測方法，不涉及任何廠商的製程細節。
history.textEn: CMOS active-pixel sensors were developed by Eric Fossum's group at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in the early 1990s to replace power-hungry CCDs that needed a dedicated process; in 2009 Andor, Fairchild Imaging and PCO jointly introduced the first scientific CMOS, whose parallel column ADCs and correlated double sampling reached about 1 electron of read noise at 100 full frames per second; around 2016 back-illuminated sCMOS pushed peak quantum efficiency to 95 percent, and in 2021 quantitative CMOS (qCMOS) brought read noise below 0.3 electron, allowing photon numbers to be resolved in a single exposure. This course collects only public physics and measurement methods, not any vendor's process details.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: CERN 大型強子對撞機
history.text: LHC 於 1994 年獲 CERN 理事會核准，建在 1989 到 2000 年運轉的 LEP 正負電子對撞機留下的 26.7 km 隧道中，以 1.9 K 超流氦冷卻的 NbTi 雙孔徑磁鐵達到 LEP 隧道半徑下所需的 8.33 T。2008 年 9 月 10 日首次有束流循環，九天後一個匯流排接頭電阻過高引發電弧與氦洩漏，修復一年後於 2009 年底重新啟動；2012 年 7 月 ATLAS 與 CMS 宣布發現希格斯玻色子，Run 2（2015–2018）在 6.5 TeV 運轉，Run 3 自 2022 年起以 6.8 TeV 達到 13.6 TeV 的對撞能量。高亮度 LHC 升級將以 Nb₃Sn 四極磁鐵與蟹形腔把亮度再提高五倍以上。本課只重建公開的設計原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: The LHC was approved by the CERN Council in 1994 and built in the 26.7 km tunnel left by the LEP electron-positron collider that ran from 1989 to 2000, using twin-aperture NbTi magnets cooled by 1.9 K superfluid helium to reach the 8.33 T demanded by the LEP tunnel radius. Beam first circulated on 10 September 2008; nine days later a bus-bar splice with excessive resistance arced and released helium, and after a year of repairs the machine restarted at the end of 2009. ATLAS and CMS announced the Higgs boson in July 2012, Run 2 (2015–2018) operated at 6.5 TeV, and Run 3 from 2022 reaches 13.6 TeV collisions at 6.8 TeV per beam. The High-Luminosity LHC upgrade will raise luminosity by more than a factor of five with Nb₃Sn quadrupoles and crab cavities. This course reconstructs only public design principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: CERN Linac4 直線加速器
history.text: Linac4 的構想源自 1990 年代末的研究，2004 到 2008 年進行研發，2008 年 10 月破土、2009 年開挖隧道，2013 年開始加速束流，2016 年達到 160 MeV，2017 年 5 月落成。它是 LHC 注入器升級計畫的一部分，在 2019 到 2020 年長停機期間取代自 1978 年起服役的 Linac2，從 2020 年起成為 LHC 質子束流的源頭。法國 CEA 與 CNRS、俄羅斯 BINP 與 VNIITF、波蘭 NCBJ、西班牙 ESS Bilbao、義大利 INFN 與印度 RRCAT 等機構參與建造，其設計在 2020 年整理成 CERN 黃皮書設計報告。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Linac4 grew from studies at the end of the 1990s, with R&D from 2004 to 2008, ground-breaking in October 2008, tunnel excavation in 2009, first accelerated beams in 2013, 160 MeV in 2016 and inauguration in May 2017. Part of the LHC Injectors Upgrade, it replaced Linac2, in service since 1978, during the 2019–2020 long shutdown and has been the source of LHC proton beams since 2020. Institutes including CEA and CNRS in France, BINP and VNIITF in Russia, NCBJ in Poland, ESS Bilbao in Spain, INFN in Italy and RRCAT in India contributed, and the design was documented in a 2020 CERN Yellow Report. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
