history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: CERN 超級質子同步加速器
history.text: SPS 於 1976 年啟用，周長約 7 km、最初能量 400 GeV，成為 CERN 粒子物理計畫的主力。1981 年起它改裝為質子—反質子對撞機 SppS，1983 年 UA1 與 UA2 實驗在此發現 W 與 Z 玻色子，Rubbia 與 van der Meer 於 1984 年獲諾貝爾物理獎。1989 至 2000 年 SPS 為 LEP 加速電子與正子，2008 年起成為 LHC 的最後一級注入器，並在 2019–2020 年 LS2 期間完成 LIU 升級。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: The SPS started up in 1976 with a circumference of about 7 km and an initial energy of 400 GeV, becoming the workhorse of CERN's particle-physics programme. From 1981 it was converted into the SppS proton–antiproton collider, where the UA1 and UA2 experiments discovered the W and Z bosons in 1983, earning Rubbia and van der Meer the 1984 Nobel Prize in Physics. From 1989 to 2000 it accelerated electrons and positrons for LEP, since 2008 it has been the last injector of the LHC, and the LIU upgrade was completed during LS2 in 2019–2020. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: CERN 反質子減速器
history.text: 1980 年代 CERN 以反質子累積器支撐 SppS 對撞，並以 LEAR 低能反質子環服務低能實驗，1995 年在 LEAR 上首次合成 9 個反氫原子。LEAR 於 1996 年關閉後，CERN 把原反質子收集環改建為 AD，2000 年開始運轉，2002 年 ATHENA 與 ATRAP 大量產生冷反氫，2011 年 ALPHA 把反氫捕捉約 16 分鐘。ELENA 於 2016 年開始試運轉，LS2 之後成為所有 AD 實驗的送束環。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In the 1980s CERN's Antiproton Accumulator fed the SppS collider while the LEAR low-energy ring served low-energy experiments, and in 1995 the first nine antihydrogen atoms were made at LEAR. After LEAR closed in 1996, CERN rebuilt the former Antiproton Collector into the AD, which began operating in 2000; in 2002 ATHENA and ATRAP produced cold antihydrogen in large numbers, and in 2011 ALPHA held antihydrogen for about 16 minutes. ELENA began commissioning in 2016 and after LS2 became the delivery ring for all AD experiments. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 台灣光子源 TPS
history.text: TPS 由國家同步輻射研究中心在新竹科學園區、緊鄰 TLS 興建，2010 年動工，施工期間還需監測地層變形以保護 TLS 運轉。儲存環採 24 單元 DBA 晶格、周長 518.4 m，增能環與儲存環同隧道同心配置；磁鐵製作與量測於 2013 年 10 月完成。2014 年 12 月 16 日增能環達 3 GeV，12 月 31 日在未開修正磁鐵下於 3 GeV 觀測到首道同步光，2015 年 12 月儲存電流超過 520 mA，2016 年起開放用戶。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: TPS was built by the National Synchrotron Radiation Research Center in Hsinchu Science Park next to TLS, with construction starting in 2010 and ground deformation monitored to protect TLS operation. The storage ring uses a 24-cell DBA lattice of 518.4 m circumference with the booster concentric in the same tunnel; magnet fabrication and measurement were completed in October 2013. The booster reached 3 GeV on 16 December 2014, first synchrotron light was seen at 3 GeV on 31 December without correctors, more than 520 mA was stored in December 2015, and user operation began in 2016. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 台灣同步輻射光源 TLS
history.text: TLS 由同步輻射研究中心（今國家同步輻射研究中心）在新竹科學園區興建，1993 年 4 月首次儲存電子束，同年 10 月開放用戶，是亞洲第一座、全球第三座第三代同步輻射光源。1996 年運轉能量由 1.3 GeV 提升到 1.5 GeV，2000 年改為全能量增能環注入，2002 年 6 T 超導波長位移器投入運轉，2005 年 2 月超導射頻腔例行運轉、10 月起實施頂注；TPS 開放後兩座光源並行服務用戶。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: TLS was built in Hsinchu Science Park by the Synchrotron Radiation Research Center, now the National Synchrotron Radiation Research Center; it first stored beam in April 1993 and opened to users that October as Asia's first and the world's third third-generation synchrotron light source. Operating energy rose from 1.3 to 1.5 GeV in 1996, full-energy booster injection followed in 2000, the 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter entered operation in 2002, and in 2005 the SRF cavity went into routine use in February and top-up began in October; since TPS opened, the two sources have served users side by side. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF
history.text: ESRF 由歐洲多國於 1988 年共同成立，1994 年開放使用者，是第一座第三代高能硬 X 光同步輻射光源。2015 至 2022 年的 EBS 升級把原本的雙彎消色散晶格換成由 Pantaleo Raimondi 提出的混合多彎消色散晶格，2018 年底停機、2020 年 8 月重新供光，在相同的 844 m 隧道、相同的光束線位置上把水平發射度降低約 30 倍、亮度與同調性提高約兩個數量級，成為第一座第四代高能儲存環。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: ESRF was founded by a group of European countries in 1988 and opened to users in 1994 as the first third-generation high-energy hard X-ray source. The 2015 to 2022 EBS upgrade replaced the double-bend achromat lattice with the hybrid multi-bend achromat proposed by Pantaleo Raimondi; the ring shut down at the end of 2018 and restarted user operation in August 2020, lowering horizontal emittance about 30-fold and raising brilliance and coherence by about two orders of magnitude inside the same 844 m tunnel with unchanged beamline positions, making it the first fourth-generation high-energy storage ring. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: Diamond Light Source 同步輻射設施
history.text: Diamond Light Source 位於英國牛津郡 Harwell 科學園區，由英國科學與技術設施委員會與 Wellcome 基金會共同出資，2007 年初開放使用者，是英國的國家級同步輻射光源，以 3 GeV、24 單元雙彎消色散儲存環運轉，並於 2000 年代後期陸續建成三十多條光束線。Diamond-II 升級計畫於 2020 年代獲得核准，將以雙三彎消色散晶格把能量提高到 3.5 GeV 並大幅降低發射度，同時保留既有光束線的光源點。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Diamond Light Source sits on the Harwell science campus in Oxfordshire, funded jointly by the UK Science and Technology Facilities Council and the Wellcome Trust; it opened to users in early 2007 as the UK's national synchrotron, running a 3 GeV, 24-cell double-bend achromat ring and building more than thirty beamlines through the late 2000s and 2010s. The Diamond-II upgrade, approved in the 2020s, will raise the energy to 3.5 GeV with a double-triple-bend achromat lattice and cut emittance sharply while preserving the source points of existing beamlines. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施
history.text: SPring-8 位於兵庫縣播磨科學公園都市，由理化學研究所與日本原子力研究所共同建造，1997 年 10 月開放使用者，以 8 GeV 成為能量最高的第三代同步輻射光源，並率先大量採用真空內波盪器。相鄰的 X 光自由電子雷射 SACLA 於 2011 年首次出光，2020 年起兼任儲存環的注入器。SPring-8-II 升級計畫由理研與 JASRI 推動，將以 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格與阻尼扭擺磁鐵把發射度降到 50 pm·rad，停機期目標約一年。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: SPring-8 stands in the Harima Science Garden City of Hyogo Prefecture, built jointly by RIKEN and the Japan Atomic Energy Research Institute; it opened to users in October 1997 as the highest-energy third-generation synchrotron at 8 GeV and pioneered the wide use of in-vacuum undulators. The neighbouring X-ray free-electron laser SACLA first lased in 2011 and has also served as the ring's injector since 2020. The SPring-8-II upgrade, driven by RIKEN and JASRI, will use a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to reach 50 pm·rad with a blackout of about one year. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
history.text: SLAC 的 3 km 直線加速器於 1966 年啟用，原為高能物理設施；1992 年 Pellegrini 等人提出用其最後一段驅動 X 光自由電子雷射，LCLS 於 2006 至 2009 年建成，2009 年 4 月以 1.5 Å 首次出光，成為全球第一座硬 X 光自由電子雷射，重複率 120 Hz。LCLS-II 在隧道前段加裝 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器與兩支可變間隙波盪器，2023 年 9 月首次出光，重複率可達 1 MHz；LCLS-II-HE 將把超導直線加速器延伸到 8 GeV。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: SLAC's 3 km linac began operation in 1966 as a high-energy-physics machine; in 1992 Pellegrini and colleagues proposed driving an X-ray free-electron laser with its final section, and LCLS was built from 2006 to 2009, first lasing at 1.5 Å in April 2009 as the world's first hard X-ray FEL at 120 Hz. LCLS-II added a 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac in the front of the tunnel and two variable-gap undulators, achieving first light in September 2023 with repetition rates up to 1 MHz; LCLS-II-HE will extend the superconducting linac to 8 GeV. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
history.text: European XFEL 建立在 DESY 主導的 TESLA 超導加速技術與漢堡 FLASH 自由電子雷射的經驗上，FLASH 驗證了以超導直線加速器驅動的 SASE 在軟 X 光波段可行。European XFEL GmbH 於 2009 年成立並開始土建，3.4 km 的隧道設施於 2017 年首次產生雷射並開放使用者實驗；之後持續擴充實驗站與 MHz 偵測器。本課只重建公開原理與設施公開資料，不涉及任何操作程序。
history.textEn: European XFEL builds on the TESLA superconducting-acceleration technology led by DESY and on the FLASH free-electron laser in Hamburg, which proved that SASE driven by a superconducting linac works in the soft X-ray range. European XFEL GmbH was founded in 2009 and civil construction began; the 3.4 km tunnel facility first lased in 2017 and opened to user experiments the same year, after which instruments and MHz detectors kept expanding. This course reconstructs only public principles and published facility data, not any operating procedure.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
history.text: ESO 於 1980 年代後期決定建造由四座 8 m 級望遠鏡組成的 VLT，並選定智利 Cerro Paranal 為站址；第一座 UT 於 1998 年取得初光，其餘三座在之後數年陸續完成，VLTI 也在 2000 年代初取得首批條紋。2016 年 UT4 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器可變形副鏡與四雷射導引星取得初光，使 VLT 從被動大口徑轉向以自適應光學與干涉為核心的平台。
history.textEn: ESO decided in the late 1980s to build the VLT as four 8 m class telescopes and chose Cerro Paranal in Chile as the site; the first UT saw first light in 1998, the other three followed over the next few years, and VLTI obtained its first fringes in the early 2000s. In 2016 the UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility reached first light with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, turning the VLT from a passive large-aperture facility into a platform built around adaptive optics and interferometry.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT
history.text: ESO 理事會於 2006 年核准極大望遠鏡的詳細研究，2010 年選定 Cerro Armazones 為站址，2014 年起動工建設通往山頂的道路。2018 年 SCHOTT 澆鑄第一批六角形主鏡鏡段，圓頂與主結構也開始施工；2024 年首批 18 片 M1 鏡段運抵智利。依 ESO 公開時程，望遠鏡預計 2029 年首次測試觀測、2030 年 12 月以科學儀器開始觀測。
history.textEn: The ESO Council approved detailed studies of the Extremely Large Telescope in 2006, Cerro Armazones was chosen as the site in 2010, and construction of the summit road began in 2014. In 2018 SCHOTT cast the first hexagonal primary segments and work on the dome and main structure began; in 2024 the first 18 M1 segments arrived in Chile. According to ESO's public timeline, the telescope is planned to make first test observations in 2029 and begin observations with scientific instruments in December 2030.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列
history.text: ALMA 由歐洲南方天文台（ESO）、美國國家科學基金會（經 NRAO）與日本國立天文台（NAOJ，含台灣與韓國的參與）合作，在智利北部查南托高原建造，2003 年動工、2011 年以部分天線開始早期科學觀測、2013 年 3 月落成；12 m 天線由北美與歐洲兩家承包團隊製造，日本負責 Morita 緊湊陣列的 16 座天線，台灣中研院天文所參與前端整合與 Band 1 接收機研製。此後陣列持續更新，包括規劃中的寬頻靈敏度升級。本課只重建公開的工程原理，不涉及任何承包商的專有設計。
history.textEn: ALMA was built on the Chajnantor plateau of northern Chile by ESO, the US National Science Foundation through NRAO, and the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (NAOJ, with Taiwan and Korea participating): construction began in 2003, early science started in 2011 with a partial array, and the observatory was inaugurated in March 2013. The 12 m antennas came from North American and European contractor teams, Japan delivered the 16 antennas of the Morita compact array, and Taiwan's ASIAA contributed front-end integration and Band 1 receiver development. The array keeps evolving, including the planned wideband sensitivity upgrade. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles, not any contractor's proprietary design.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT
history.text: ESO 的 Ray Wilson 等人在 1980 年代發展主動光學理論，NTT 是第一座以此原則設計的望遠鏡：3.58 m Zerodur 薄鏡坯由 Schott 鑄造，光學拋光由 Carl Zeiss 完成，八角形旋轉圓頂由義大利承包團隊於 1986 至 1989 年建造，1989 年 3 月 23 日在拉西拉天文台取得首光並得到當時少見的 0.3″ 級星像。1997 年的全面升級把控制系統改為 VLT 架構，使 NTT 成為 VLT 的技術原型；它至今仍以 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器運作。本課只重建公開的工程原理。
history.textEn: Ray Wilson and colleagues at ESO developed active-optics theory in the 1980s, and the NTT was the first telescope designed on that principle: the 3.58 m Zerodur meniscus was cast by Schott and polished by Carl Zeiss, the octagonal rotating enclosure was built by an Italian contractor team between 1986 and 1989, and first light at La Silla on 23 March 1989 delivered images near 0.3″, exceptional at the time. The 1997 overhaul rebuilt the control system on the VLT architecture, making the NTT the technical prototype of the VLT; it still operates with instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡
history.text: VISTA 由以倫敦瑪麗王后大學為首的 18 所英國大學聯盟提出，作為英國加入 ESO 的實物貢獻，由 STFC 的英國天文技術中心管理設計與建造，2009 年 12 月 10 日通過 ESO 臨時驗收、12 月 11 日取得首光，隨後以 VIRCAM 執行 VVV、VHS、VIKING、VIDEO、UltraVISTA 等公開巡天十餘年。VIRCAM 於 2023 年退役，望遠鏡改裝 4MOST 多目標光纖光譜儀以進行大規模光譜巡天。本課只重建公開的工程原理與數據邏輯。
history.textEn: VISTA was proposed by a consortium of 18 UK universities led by Queen Mary University of London as the UK's in-kind contribution on joining ESO, with design and construction managed by the STFC UK Astronomy Technology Centre; ESO granted provisional acceptance on 10 December 2009 and first light followed on 11 December, after which VIRCAM carried out public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING, VIDEO and UltraVISTA for more than a decade. VIRCAM was retired in 2023 and the telescope was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph for large spectroscopic surveys. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles and data logic.

history.title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
history.text: Rainer Weiss 在 1972 年的 MIT 報告中列出雷射干涉重力波偵測器的雜訊預算，之後與 Kip Thorne、Ronald Drever 推動由美國國家科學基金會資助的 LIGO 計畫；漢福德與利文斯頓兩站於 1990 年代末建成，初代 LIGO 在 2002 至 2010 年運行而未偵測到訊號。Advanced LIGO 於 2015 年啟用，同年 9 月 14 日記錄到第一個雙黑洞合併事件 GW150914，2017 年諾貝爾物理獎授予 Weiss、Barish 與 Thorne；之後各次觀測運行逐步加入壓縮光、頻率相依壓縮與更高功率。本課只重建公開文獻中的工程原理，不涉及任何內部設計文件。
history.textEn: Rainer Weiss's 1972 MIT report laid out the noise budget of a laser-interferometric gravitational-wave detector, and with Kip Thorne and Ronald Drever he drove the LIGO project funded by the US National Science Foundation; the Hanford and Livingston sites were completed in the late 1990s, and Initial LIGO ran from 2002 to 2010 without a detection. Advanced LIGO began operating in 2015 and on 14 September that year recorded the first binary-black-hole merger, GW150914; the 2017 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Weiss, Barish and Thorne, and subsequent observing runs added squeezed light, frequency-dependent squeezing and higher power. This course reconstructs only the engineering principles in public literature, not any internal design document.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型

history.text: 本課把「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」到「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" through "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

references.scopeEn: Official explanation of the 4 km arms, about 280 round trips in the Fabry–Pérot arm cavities, power recycling from 200 W to about 750 kW and the role of signal recycling.

references.scopeEn: Official technology overview: 40 kg test masses with nanometre-scale multilayer coatings, the four-stage pendulum (two 20 kg metal stages above two 40 kg silica stages), active and passive isolation and the ultra-high vacuum.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
history.text: Virgo 由 Adalberto Giazotto 與 Alain Brillet 於 1987 年提出，1989 年向法國 CNRS 與義大利 INFN 提案並於 1990 年代初獲准，1997 年在比薩附近的卡希納動工、2003 年落成，2000 年成立歐洲重力觀測站（EGO）負責營運；2007 年開始科學觀測並與 LIGO 簽署聯合運作協議。Advanced Virgo 升級於 2017 年完成，隨即在 2017 年 8 月 14 日參與 GW170814 的三站偵測，三天後的 GW170817 開啟多信使天文學；之後的升級加入訊號循環與頻率相依壓縮光。本課只重建公開文獻中的工程原理。
history.textEn: Virgo was proposed by Adalberto Giazotto and Alain Brillet in 1987, submitted to France's CNRS and Italy's INFN in 1989 and approved in the early 1990s; construction at Cascina near Pisa began in 1997, the detector was inaugurated in 2003, and the European Gravitational Observatory (EGO) was founded in 2000 to operate it; science observations began in 2007 together with a joint-operation agreement with LIGO. The Advanced Virgo upgrade was completed in 2017 and the detector joined the three-site detection of GW170814 on 14 August 2017, followed three days later by GW170817, which opened multi-messenger astronomy; later upgrades added signal recycling and frequency-dependent squeezing. This course reconstructs only engineering principles found in public literature.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡
history.text: KAGRA 計畫於 2010 年啟動，2012 年 1 月在神岡舉行動工典禮，2014 年 3 月完成坑道開挖。2016 年 3 月以室溫熔融石英鏡進行簡易麥克森運轉（iKAGRA），2018 年 4 月完成首次低溫運轉測試，2019 年完成基線設計配置。2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測並於同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測，之後參與 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 的第四輪觀測，在能登半島地震後修復並於 2025 年恢復觀測。
history.textEn: The KAGRA project started in 2010, held its ground-breaking ceremony at Kamioka in January 2012 and completed tunnel excavation in March 2014. In March 2016 it ran a simple room-temperature Michelson with fused-silica mirrors (iKAGRA), in April 2018 it completed its first cryogenic test operation, and in 2019 it finished installation of the baseline design. It began observing in February 2020, observed jointly with GEO600 that April, then took part in the fourth LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA observing run, recovering from the Noto Peninsula earthquake and resuming observation in 2025.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡
history.text: FAST 由南仁東等人在 1994 年前後提出，構想源自利用貴州喀斯特窪地建造大型電波望遠鏡的研究，經過數百個窪地的勘查後選定大窩凼。工程於 2011 年 3 月開工、2016 年 9 月落成，2020 年 1 月通過國家驗收並正式運行，2021 年起向國際開放；到 2024 年 11 月已發現超過 1000 顆新脈衝星。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: FAST was proposed around 1994 by Nan Rendong and colleagues from studies of building a giant radio telescope in Guizhou's karst depressions, and Dawodang was chosen after surveying hundreds of candidates. Construction began in March 2011, the telescope was completed in September 2016, passed national acceptance and entered formal operation in January 2020, and opened to international users from 2021; by November 2024 it had found more than 1000 new pulsars. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
